tm91.flavor_text_es: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Psíquico y los Pokémon que están en el suelo quedan protegidos contra movimientos con prioridad.
tm91.flavor_text_en: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

tm92.name: TM92
tm92.flavor_text_es: El usuario lanza por la boca una singular llama a gran temperatura con la que ataca a su oponente y baja su Ataque Especial.
tm92.flavor_text_en: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

hm07.name: HM07
hm07.flavor_text_es: Ataca sumergiéndose en el agua en el primer turno y emergiendo violentamente en el segundo.
hm07.flavor_text_en: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

hm08.name: HM08
hm08.flavor_text_en: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

explorer-kit.name: Explorer Kit
explorer-kit.flavor_text_es: Una saca donde guardar los objetos útiles para la exploración. Permite acceder al Subsuelo.
explorer-kit.flavor_text_en: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground in the Sinnoh region.

loot-sack.name: Loot Sack
loot-sack.flavor_text_es: Una saca grande y resistente utilizada para transportar el botín reunido en la mina de carbón.
loot-sack.flavor_text_en: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.

rule-book.name: Rule Book
rule-book.flavor_text_es: Recoge las normas de los combates. En los combates en conexión puedes elegir el conjunto de reglas que quieres usar.
rule-book.flavor_text_en: It lists the rules for holding battles. For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

poke-radar.name: Poké Radar
poke-radar.flavor_text_es: Busca Pokémon que se esconden en la hierba. La batería se recarga mientras caminas.
poke-radar.flavor_text_en: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

point-card.name: Point Card
point-card.flavor_text_es: Una tarjeta en la que se registran los Puntos de Batalla que has ganado.
point-card.flavor_text_en: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.

journal.name: Journal
journal.flavor_text_es: Un cuaderno en el que se recogen, día a día, los progresos de tu aventura.
journal.flavor_text_en: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

seal-case.name: Seal Case
seal-case.flavor_text_es: Caja en la que se pueden guardar los sellos que se aplican a las cápsulas de las Poké Balls.
seal-case.flavor_text_en: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poké Balls.

fashion-case.name: Fashion Case
fashion-case.flavor_text_es: Una bonita cajita donde guardar todos los Complementos para vestir a tus Pokémon en el Teatro Musical.
fashion-case.flavor_text_en: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

seal-bag.name: Seal Bag
seal-bag.flavor_text_es: Bolsita con capacidad para diez sellos de los que decoran las Poké Balls.
seal-bag.flavor_text_en: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

pal-pad.name: Pal Pad
pal-pad.flavor_text_es: Un cuaderno muy práctico en el que puedes registrar amigos, claves de amigo, etc.
pal-pad.flavor_text_en: A convenient notepad that is used to register your friends and friend codes and keep a record of your gameplay.

works-key.name: Works Key
works-key.flavor_text_es: Abre la puerta de la Central del Valle Eólico. La llevaba un Recluta del Equipo Galaxia.
works-key.flavor_text_en: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

old-charm.name: Old Charm
old-charm.flavor_text_es: Está hecho con huesos de Pokémon y trae buena suerte. Hay que llevárselo a la anciana de Pueblo Caelestis.
old-charm.flavor_text_en: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

galactic-key.name: Galactic Key
galactic-key.flavor_text_es: Desactiva los sistemas de seguridad de la Base Galaxia. Por lo visto, perder esta tarjeta se castiga severamente.
galactic-key.flavor_text_en: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

red-chain.name: Red Chain
red-chain.flavor_text_es: Se dice que esta cadena mística está relacionada con el Pokémon legendario que creó la región de Sinnoh.
red-chain.flavor_text_en: A mythical chain that is said to link the Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

town-map.name: Town Map
town-map.flavor_text_es: Un mapa muy útil que puede consultarse en cualquier momento y que, además, te indica dónde te encuentras.
town-map.flavor_text_en: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.

vs-seeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vs-seeker.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo que busca Entrenadores listos para el combate. La batería se carga mientras caminas.
vs-seeker.flavor_text_en: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

coin-case.name: Coin Case
coin-case.flavor_text_es: Puedes obtenerlo en la Sala de Juegos. Tiene capacidad para 50 000 fichas.
coin-case.flavor_text_en: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.

old-rod.name: Old Rod
old-rod.flavor_text_es: Caña de pescar bastante usada y desgastada. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
old-rod.flavor_text_en: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

good-rod.name: Good Rod
good-rod.flavor_text_es: Caña de pescar nuevecita y de gran calidad. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
good-rod.flavor_text_en: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

super-rod.name: Super Rod
super-rod.flavor_text_es: Increíble caña de pescar de alta tecnología. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
super-rod.flavor_text_en: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

sprayduck.name: Sprayduck
sprayduck.flavor_text_es: Una regadera con forma de Psyduck. Ayuda a que las bayas plantadas en suelo fértil crezcan mejor.
sprayduck.flavor_text_en: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

poffin-case.name: Poffin Case
poffin-case.flavor_text_es: Caja en la que se transportan los Pokochos elaborados con bayas.
poffin-case.flavor_text_en: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.flavor_text_en: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.

suite-key.name: Suite Key
suite-key.flavor_text_es: Llave de una suite del hotel de lujo junto al lago. Por algún motivo, se pierde a menudo.
suite-key.flavor_text_en: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

oaks-letter.name: Oak’s Letter
oaks-letter.flavor_text_es: Carta del Profesor Oak en la que se te pide que vayas a la Ruta 224.
oaks-letter.flavor_text_en: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.

lunar-wing.name: Lunar Wing
lunar-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que brilla como la luna. Se dice que tiene el poder de disipar pesadillas.
lunar-wing.flavor_text_en: A feather that glows like the moon. It’s said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

member-card.name: Member Card
member-card.flavor_text_es: Necesario para entrar en la posada de Ciudad Canal. Es extraño, pero la última fecha registrada es de hace 50 años.
member-card.flavor_text_en: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

azure-flute.name: Azure Flute
azure-flute.flavor_text_es: Emite sonidos que no parecen de este mundo. Es de fabricante desconocido.
azure-flute.flavor_text_en: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it.

ss-ticket.name: S.S. Ticket
ss-ticket.flavor_text_es: Es el billete válido para embarcar en el Ferry S.S. Aqua. Tiene dibujado un barco.
ss-ticket.flavor_text_en: A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on its front.

contest-pass.name: Contest Pass
contest-pass.flavor_text_es: Es necesario para participar en Concursos Pokémon. Tiene una cinta de ganador dibujada.
contest-pass.flavor_text_en: A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.

magma-stone.name: Magma Stone
magma-stone.flavor_text_es: Formada a partir de magma enfriado y endurecido. Aún hay magma líquido en su interior.
magma-stone.flavor_text_en: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.

parcel.name: Parcel
parcel.flavor_text_es: Paquete encomendado a tu cuidado que tienes que entregar a tu amigo de la infancia que dejó Pueblo Hojaverde.
parcel.flavor_text_en: A parcel entrusted into your care. You’re supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

coupon-1.name: Coupon 1
coupon-1.flavor_text_es: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-1.flavor_text_en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

coupon-2.name: Coupon 2
coupon-2.flavor_text_es: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-2.flavor_text_en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

coupon-3.name: Coupon 3
coupon-3.flavor_text_es: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-3.flavor_text_en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

storage-key.name: Storage Key
storage-key.flavor_text_es: Llave del siniestro almacén del Equipo Galaxia que está ubicado en las afueras de Ciudad Rocavelo.
storage-key.flavor_text_en: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

secret-potion.name: Secret Potion
secret-potion.flavor_text_es: Fantástico medicamento vendido en la farmacia de Ciudad Orquídea. Cura completamente a un Pokémon.
secret-potion.flavor_text_en: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

griseous-orb.name: Griseous Orb
griseous-orb.flavor_text_es: Una esfera brillante que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón y Fantasma. Debe llevarla Giratina.
griseous-orb.flavor_text_en: A glowing orb to be held by Giratina. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves when it is held.

vs-recorder.name: Vs. Recorder
vs-recorder.flavor_text_es: Un fantástico dispositivo que graba combates entre amigos o celebrados en algún recinto especial.
vs-recorder.flavor_text_en: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.

gracidea.name: Gracidea
gracidea.flavor_text_es: Una flor que se suele regalar en ramos para expresar agradecimiento en ocasiones especiales, como cumpleaños.
gracidea.flavor_text_en: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.

secret-key.name: Secret Key
secret-key.flavor_text_es: Una llave de alta tecnología que debe usarse en un lugar concreto. Emite una señal eléctrica que abre una puerta.
secret-key.flavor_text_en: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.

apricorn-box.name: Apricorn Box
apricorn-box.flavor_text_es: Práctico recipiente que puede almacenar hasta 99 Bonguri de cada especie.
apricorn-box.flavor_text_en: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.

berry-pots.name: Berry Pots
berry-pots.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo portátil de cultivo que permite plantar bayas en cualquier momento de forma sencilla.
berry-pots.flavor_text_en: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

squirt-bottle.name: Squirt Bottle
squirt-bottle.flavor_text_es: Objeto que contiene agua y se usa para regar las bayas del Plantabayas.
squirt-bottle.flavor_text_en: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

lure-ball.name: Lure Ball
lure-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta, especialmente indicada para capturar los Pokémon que se han pescado con una caña.
lure-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.

level-ball.name: Level Ball
level-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta que funciona especialmente bien con Pokémon de nivel inferior a los que se posee.
level-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are at a lower level than your own Pokémon.

moon-ball.name: Moon Ball
moon-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta que atrapa con más facilidad los Pokémon que evolucionan con la Piedra Lunar.
moon-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.

heavy-ball.name: Heavy Ball
heavy-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta que funciona especialmente bien a la hora de atrapar Pokémon de mucho peso.
heavy-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.

fast-ball.name: Fast Ball
fast-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta, especialmente indicada para capturar Pokémon evasivos.
fast-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are usually very quick to run away.

friend-ball.name: Friend Ball
friend-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta que hace más amistosos a los Pokémon salvajes que se capturan con ella.
friend-ball.flavor_text_en: A strange Poké Ball that will make the wild Pokémon caught with it more friendly toward you immediately.

love-ball.name: Love Ball
love-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball algo distinta que atrapa mejor Pokémon de la misma especie que los que se posee, pero de sexo diferente.
love-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball that works best when catching a Pokémon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokémon.

park-ball.name: Park Ball
park-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball que se utiliza dentro del Parque Compi.
park-ball.flavor_text_en: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.

sport-ball.name: Sport Ball
sport-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball especial que se utilizaba en el Concurso de Captura de Bichos de la región de Johto.
sport-ball.flavor_text_en: A special Poké Ball that was used during the Bug-Catching Contest in the Johto region.

red-apricorn.name: Red Apricorn
red-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color rojo y aroma muy penetrante.
red-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

blue-apricorn.name: Blue Apricorn
blue-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color azul y aroma tierno.
blue-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

yellow-apricorn.name: Yellow Apricorn
yellow-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color amarillo y aroma refrescante.
yellow-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

green-apricorn.name: Green Apricorn
green-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color verde y aroma peculiar que recuerda al café tostado.
green-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

pink-apricorn.name: Pink Apricorn
pink-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color rosa y aroma dulce.
pink-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

white-apricorn.name: White Apricorn
white-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color blanco que no desprende aroma alguno.
white-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A white Apricorn. It doesn’t smell like anything.

black-apricorn.name: Black Apricorn
black-apricorn.flavor_text_es: Bonguri de color negro y aroma indescriptible.
black-apricorn.flavor_text_en: A black Apricorn. It has a scent beyond one’s experience.

dowsing-machine.name: Dowsing Machine
dowsing-machine.flavor_text_es: Aparato de precisión que reacciona ante objetos que no se ven. Para usarlo, es necesario colocárselo en la cabeza.
dowsing-machine.flavor_text_en: A high-tech machine that shows the location of invisible items. It’s attached to the head when in use.

rage-candy-bar.name: Rage Candy Bar
rage-candy-bar.flavor_text_es: Caramelo típico de Pueblo Caoba. Cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
rage-candy-bar.flavor_text_en: Mahogany Town’s famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

red-orb.name: Red Orb
red-orb.flavor_text_es: Piedra carmesí de la que se dice que guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
red-orb.flavor_text_en: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

blue-orb.name: Blue Orb
blue-orb.flavor_text_es: Piedra añil que, según dicen, guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
blue-orb.flavor_text_en: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

jade-orb.name: Jade Orb
jade-orb.flavor_text_es: Esfera glauca de la que se dice que guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
jade-orb.flavor_text_en: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.

enigma-stone.name: Enigma Stone
enigma-stone.flavor_text_es: Esfera cristalina encontrada bajo tierra. A pesar de estar cubierta de roca y tierra, su belleza es increíble.
enigma-stone.flavor_text_en: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. It’s a very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.

unown-report.name: Unown Report
unown-report.flavor_text_es: Bloc que almacena la información de los Unown capturados hasta el momento.
unown-report.flavor_text_en: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.

blue-card.name: Blue Card
blue-card.flavor_text_es: Tarjeta para conseguir puntos con el programa de radio Las contraseñas de Buena.
blue-card.flavor_text_en: A card to save points for the Buena’s Password show.

slowpoke-tail.name: Slowpoke Tail
slowpoke-tail.flavor_text_es: Sabrosa cola de origen desconocido. Se puede comprar a un precio muy elevado.
slowpoke-tail.flavor_text_en: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

clear-bell.name: Clear Bell
clear-bell.flavor_text_es: Cascabel de aspecto antiguo que emite un sonido que calma el espíritu.
clear-bell.flavor_text_en: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.

card-key.name: Card Key
card-key.flavor_text_es: Llave con forma de tarjeta que abre las puertas de la Torre Radio.
card-key.flavor_text_en: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

basement-key.name: Basement Key
basement-key.flavor_text_es: Llave que abre la puerta que hay en el Túnel Trigal.
basement-key.flavor_text_en: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

red-scale.name: Red Scale
red-scale.flavor_text_es: Escama del Gyarados aparecido en el Lago de la Furia. Es de un rojo tan intenso como las llamas.
red-scale.flavor_text_en: A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.

lost-item.name: Lost Item
lost-item.flavor_text_es: El muñeco Mime Jr. que perdió la Copiona.
lost-item.flavor_text_en: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.

pass.name: Pass
pass.flavor_text_es: Billete necesario para poder montar todas las veces que se desee en el Magnetotrén.
pass.flavor_text_en: A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you’d like.

machine-part.name: Machine Part
machine-part.flavor_text_es: Valiosa pieza robada de una máquina de la Central Energía.
machine-part.flavor_text_en: An important part of a machine that was stolen from the Power Plant.

silver-wing.name: Silver Wing
silver-wing.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa ala de un brillante color plateado.
silver-wing.flavor_text_en: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

rainbow-wing.name: Rainbow Wing
rainbow-wing.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa ala de un brillante color arcoíris.
rainbow-wing.flavor_text_en: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.

mystery-egg.name: Mystery Egg
mystery-egg.flavor_text_es: Misterioso Huevo con dibujos que obtienes del Sr. Pokémon. Nadie sabe qué contiene.
mystery-egg.flavor_text_en: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What is in the Egg is unknown.

gb-sounds.name: GB Sounds
gb-sounds.flavor_text_es: Lector con el que se pueden escuchar aquellas canciones tan nostálgicas. Se cambia con un solo interruptor.
gb-sounds.flavor_text_en: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It’s operated with the flip of a single switch.

tidal-bell.name: Tidal Bell
tidal-bell.flavor_text_es: Cascabel de aspecto antiguo que emite un sonido que calma el espíritu.
tidal-bell.flavor_text_en: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.

data-card-01.name: Data Card 01
data-card-01.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias.
data-card-01.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many victories you have had in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-02.name: Data Card 02
data-card-02.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se ha quedado en último lugar.
data-card-02.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many losses you have had in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-03.name: Data Card 03
data-card-03.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de sprints de los Pokémon.
data-card-03.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon dashed in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-04.name: Data Card 04
data-card-04.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de saltos de los Pokémon.
data-card-04.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon jumped in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-05.name: Data Card 05
data-card-05.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Saltaobstáculos.
data-card-05.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Hurdle Dash.

data-card-06.name: Data Card 06
data-card-06.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Carrera de Relevos.
data-card-06.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Relay Run.

data-card-07.name: Data Card 07
data-card-07.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Atrapabanderas.
data-card-07.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Pennant Capture.

data-card-08.name: Data Card 08
data-card-08.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Rompelosas.
data-card-08.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Block Smash.

data-card-09.name: Data Card 09
data-card-09.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Atrapadiscos.
data-card-09.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Disc Catch.

data-card-10.name: Data Card 10
data-card-10.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Nieve Cruzada.
data-card-10.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Snow Throw.

data-card-11.name: Data Card 11
data-card-11.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de puntos conseguidos.
data-card-11.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many points your Pokémon scored in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-12.name: Data Card 12
data-card-12.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de derrotas.
data-card-12.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon failed in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-13.name: Data Card 13
data-card-13.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de puntos perdidos por tus Pokémon.
data-card-13.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon impeded themselves.

data-card-14.name: Data Card 14
data-card-14.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de placajes realizados.
data-card-14.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon tackled in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-15.name: Data Card 15
data-card-15.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de caídas que han sufrido tus Pokémon.
data-card-15.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon fell down in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-16.name: Data Card 16
data-card-16.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Fuera del Ring.
data-card-16.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Ring Drop.

data-card-17.name: Data Card 17
data-card-17.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Botaluces.
data-card-17.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Lamp Jump.

data-card-18.name: Data Card 18
data-card-18.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Pisacírculos.
data-card-18.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Circle Push.

data-card-19.name: Data Card 19
data-card-19.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en conexión.
data-card-19.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon wins you have had.

data-card-20.name: Data Card 20
data-card-20.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se ha quedado en último lugar en conexión.
data-card-20.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon losses you have had.

data-card-21.name: Data Card 21
data-card-21.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en una disciplina.
data-card-21.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you have won a Pokéathlon event.

data-card-22.name: Data Card 22
data-card-22.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se ha terminado en última posición en una disciplina.
data-card-22.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you have lost a Pokéathlon event.

data-card-23.name: Data Card 23
data-card-23.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se ha cambiado de Pokémon.
data-card-23.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you switched Pokémon in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-24.name: Data Card 24
data-card-24.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias en Metegoles.
data-card-24.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you won the Pokéathlon’s Goal Roll.

data-card-25.name: Data Card 25
data-card-25.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de premios individuales.
data-card-25.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon won individual prizes.

data-card-26.name: Data Card 26
data-card-26.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se tocó con el lápiz a los Pokémon.
data-card-26.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you instructed your Pokémon.

data-card-27.name: Data Card 27
data-card-27.flavor_text_es: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el tiempo que se ha pasado en esta competición.
data-card-27.flavor_text_en: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how much time you spent participating in the Pokéathlon.

lock-capsule.name: Lock Capsule
lock-capsule.flavor_text_es: Una cápsula resistente que solo puede abrirse con una llave especial.
lock-capsule.flavor_text_en: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.

photo-album.name: Photo Album
photo-album.flavor_text_es: Álbum que recoge las fotos que se toman a lo largo de la aventura.
photo-album.flavor_text_en: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.

orange-mail.name: Orange Mail
orange-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute ZIGZAGOON print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

harbor-mail.name: Harbor Mail
harbor-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute WINGULL print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

glitter-mail.name: Glitter Mail
glitter-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute PIKACHU print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

mech-mail.name: Mech Mail
mech-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute MAGNEMITE print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

wood-mail.name: Wood Mail
wood-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute SLAKOTH print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

wave-mail.name: Wave Mail
wave-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute WAILMER print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

bead-mail.name: Bead Mail
bead-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL to be held by a POKéMON. It will bear the print of the POKéMON holding it.

shadow-mail.name: Shadow Mail
shadow-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute DUSKULL print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

tropic-mail.name: Tropic Mail
tropic-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute BELLOSSOM print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

dream-mail.name: Dream Mail
dream-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL to be held by a POKéMON. It will bear the print of the POKéMON holding it.

fab-mail.name: Fab Mail
fab-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a gorgeous, extravagant print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

retro-mail.name: Retro Mail
retro-mail.flavor_text_en: A piece of MAIL featuring a print of three cute POKéMON. It is to be held by a POKéMON.

mach-bike.name: Mach Bike
mach-bike.flavor_text_es: Bicicleta plegable que va a más del doble de velocidad que otras.
mach-bike.flavor_text_en: This folding bike more than doubles your movement speed.

acro-bike.name: Acro Bike
acro-bike.flavor_text_es: Bicicleta plegable capaz de correr sobre una sola rueda, realizar saltos y otras acrobacias.
acro-bike.flavor_text_en: This folding bike allows you to perform actions such as wheelies and bunny hops.

wailmer-pail.name: Wailmer Pail
wailmer-pail.flavor_text_es: Regadera con forma de Wailmer. Muy útil para que crezcan las bayas plantadas.
wailmer-pail.flavor_text_en: This is a tool for watering Berries you planted to make them grow more quickly.

devon-goods.name: Devon Goods
devon-goods.flavor_text_en: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the DEVON CORPORATION.

soot-sack.name: Soot Sack
soot-sack.flavor_text_es: Bolsa en la que recoger la ceniza de volcán sedimentada en el suelo.
soot-sack.flavor_text_en: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.

pokeblock-case.name: Pokéblock Case
pokeblock-case.flavor_text_en: A case for holding POKéBLOCKS made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one POKéBLOCK when shaken.

letter.name: Letter
letter.flavor_text_es: Carta que te ha confiado el presidente de Devon S. A.
letter.flavor_text_en: An extremely important letter to Steven from the president of Devon Corporation.

eon-ticket.name: Eon Ticket
eon-ticket.flavor_text_es: Billete de barco para viajar a Isla del Sur. Es posible que Norman, Líder de Gimnasio de Ciudad Petalia, sepa algo al respecto.
eon-ticket.flavor_text_en: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to the Southern Island. Does Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader, know a secret?!

scanner.name: Scanner
scanner.flavor_text_es: Objeto hallado en el interior de Malvamar.
scanner.flavor_text_en: A device found inside Sea Mauville.

go-goggles.name: Go-Goggles
go-goggles.flavor_text_es: Gafas idóneas para protegerte los ojos de las tormentas de arena del desierto.
go-goggles.flavor_text_en: Nifty goggles to protect eyes from desert sandstorms.

meteorite.name: Meteorite
meteorite.flavor_text_es: Meteorito obtenido en el Monte Cenizo que antes se encontraba en la Cascada Meteoro.
meteorite.flavor_text_en: A Meteorite originally found at Meteor Falls. You got it at Mt. Chimney.

rm-1-key.name: Rm. 1 Key
rm-1-key.flavor_text_en: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-2-key.name: Rm. 2 Key
rm-2-key.flavor_text_en: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-4-key.name: Rm. 4 Key
rm-4-key.flavor_text_en: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

rm-6-key.name: Rm. 6 Key
rm-6-key.flavor_text_en: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

devon-scope.name: Devon Scope
devon-scope.flavor_text_es: Artilugio creado por Devon S. A. que reacciona a la presencia de Pokémon invisibles emitiendo sonidos.
devon-scope.flavor_text_en: A special device made by Devon Corporation that signals the presence of any unseen Pokémon.

oaks-parcel.name: Oak’s Parcel
oaks-parcel.flavor_text_en: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY’s POKéMON MART.

poke-flute.name: Poké Flute
poke-flute.flavor_text_es: Una flauta con un timbre tan dulce y hermoso que despierta hasta al Pokémon más profundamente dormido.
poke-flute.flavor_text_en: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves woken up.

bike-voucher.name: Bike Voucher
bike-voucher.flavor_text_en: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

gold-teeth.name: Gold Teeth
gold-teeth.flavor_text_es: Unos dientes de oro que perdió el Guarda de la Zona Safari con los que tiene una sonrisa deslumbrante.
gold-teeth.flavor_text_en: A set of golden false teeth lost by the Safari Zone’s warden. They make his smile sparkle.

lift-key.name: Lift Key
lift-key.flavor_text_es: Llave que permite acceder al ascensor de la Guarida del Team Rocket. Lleva grabado el símbolo del Team Rocket.
lift-key.flavor_text_en: A key that operates the elevator in the Team Rocket Hideout. It bears the Team Rocket logo.

silph-scope.name: Silph Scope
silph-scope.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo que permite ver cosas que, de otra forma, resultarían invisibles para el ojo humano. Fabricado por Silph S. A.
silph-scope.flavor_text_en: A scope that lets you see what cannot usually be seen. It is made by Silph Co.

fame-checker.name: Fame Checker
fame-checker.flavor_text_en: A device that enables you to recall what you’ve heard and seen about famous people.

berry-pouch.name: Berry Pouch
berry-pouch.flavor_text_en: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG’s compartment for important items.

teachy-tv.name: Teachy TV
teachy-tv.flavor_text_en: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

tri-pass.name: Tri-Pass
tri-pass.flavor_text_en: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

rainbow-pass.name: Rainbow Pass
rainbow-pass.flavor_text_en: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

tea.name: Tea
tea.flavor_text_es: Un aromático té de sabor ligeramente amargo que resulta ideal para aplacar la sed.
tea.flavor_text_en: Aromatic tea that has a slightly bitter taste. It soothes a dry throat.

mysticticket.name: MysticTicket
mysticticket.flavor_text_en: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

auroraticket.name: AuroraTicket
auroraticket.flavor_text_en: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

powder-jar.name: Powder Jar
powder-jar.flavor_text_en: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.flavor_text_en: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.flavor_text_en: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.

magma-emblem.name: Magma Emblem
magma-emblem.flavor_text_en: A medal-like item in the same shape as TEAM MAGMA’s mark.

old-sea-map.name: Old Sea Map
old-sea-map.flavor_text_en: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.

douse-drive.name: Douse Drive
douse-drive.flavor_text_es: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Agua.
douse-drive.flavor_text_en: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Water type.

shock-drive.name: Shock Drive
shock-drive.flavor_text_es: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico.
shock-drive.flavor_text_en: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Electric type.

burn-drive.name: Burn Drive
burn-drive.flavor_text_es: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Fuego.
burn-drive.flavor_text_en: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Fire type.

chill-drive.name: Chill Drive
chill-drive.flavor_text_es: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Hielo.
chill-drive.flavor_text_en: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Ice type.

sweet-heart.name: Sweet Heart
sweet-heart.flavor_text_es: Chocolatina de sabor dulce. Restaura 20 PS de un Pokémon.
sweet-heart.flavor_text_en: A piece of cloyingly sweet chocolate. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.

greet-mail.name: Greet Mail
greet-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para presentarse a alguien. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
greet-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to be easy to use when writing someone for the first time. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

favored-mail.name: Favored Mail
favored-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para escribir sobre tus cosas favoritas. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
favored-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to make it easier to write about your favorite things. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

rsvp-mail.name: RSVP Mail
rsvp-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para invitar a un compañero. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
rsvp-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to allow you to extend an invitation to the recipient. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

thanks-mail.name: Thanks Mail
thanks-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta de agradecimiento. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
thanks-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to make it easy for you to express thanks. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

inquiry-mail.name: Inquiry Mail
inquiry-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para preguntar a un compañero. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
inquiry-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to make it easier to pose a question about something. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

like-mail.name: Like Mail
like-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para recomendar algo. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
like-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to allow you to recommend something to the reader. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

reply-mail.name: Reply Mail
reply-mail.flavor_text_es: Carta para responder a un mensaje. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
reply-mail.flavor_text_en: Stationery designed to make it easy to respond to a letter you received. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

bridge-mail-s.name: Bridge Mail S
bridge-mail-s.flavor_text_es: Carta con la imagen de un puente que se alza hacia el cielo. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
bridge-mail-s.flavor_text_en: Stationery featuring an illustration of a bridge that seems to pierce the sky. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

bridge-mail-d.name: Bridge Mail D
bridge-mail-d.flavor_text_es: Carta con la imagen de un puente levadizo de color rojo. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
bridge-mail-d.flavor_text_en: Stationery featuring an illustration of a bright-red drawbridge. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

bridge-mail-t.name: Bridge Mail T
bridge-mail-t.flavor_text_es: Carta con la imagen de un puente colgante de acero. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
bridge-mail-t.flavor_text_en: Stationery featuring an illustration of a high-tension steel suspension bridge. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

bridge-mail-v.name: Bridge Mail V
bridge-mail-v.flavor_text_es: Carta con la imagen de un puente de ladrillos. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
bridge-mail-v.flavor_text_en: Stationery featuring an illustration of a vintage-looking brick bridge. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

bridge-mail-m.name: Bridge Mail M
bridge-mail-m.flavor_text_es: Carta con la imagen de un puente con varios arcos. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
bridge-mail-m.flavor_text_en: Stationery featuring an illustration of a majestically arched bridge. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

prism-scale.name: Prism Scale
prism-scale.flavor_text_es: Curiosa escama que hace evolucionar a cierto Pokémon. Brilla con los colores del arcoíris.
prism-scale.flavor_text_en: A mysterious scale that causes a certain Pokémon to evolve. It shines in rainbow colors.

eviolite.name: Eviolite
eviolite.flavor_text_es: Roca misteriosa. El Pokémon portador aumentará su Defensa y su Defensa Especial si aún puede evolucionar.
eviolite.flavor_text_en: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held by a Pokémon that can still evolve, it raises both Defense and Sp. Def.

float-stone.name: Float Stone
float-stone.flavor_text_es: Piedra muy ligera que reduce el peso del Pokémon que la lleve.
float-stone.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This very light stone reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.

rocky-helmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rocky-helmet.flavor_text_es: Si el portador es alcanzado por un movimiento de contacto, el agresor también recibe daño.
rocky-helmet.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.

air-balloon.name: Air Balloon
air-balloon.flavor_text_es: El Pokémon que lo lleve flotará en el aire. Si recibe un golpe, estallará.
air-balloon.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once the holder is hit, this item will burst.

red-card.name: Red Card
red-card.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa tarjeta que permite al Pokémon que la lleva expulsar al oponente cuando este le cause daño.
red-card.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit by an attack, the attacker is removed from battle.

ring-target.name: Ring Target
ring-target.flavor_text_es: El Pokémon que lo lleva es vulnerable frente a movimientos que normalmente no afectan a su tipo.
ring-target.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Moves that normally have no effect will land on a Pokémon holding it.

binding-band.name: Binding Band
binding-band.flavor_text_es: Banda que potencia los movimientos que estrujan al rival.
binding-band.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a band that increases the power of binding moves used by the holder.

absorb-bulb.name: Absorb Bulb
absorb-bulb.flavor_text_es: Aumenta el Ataque Especial del portador si le alcanza un ataque de tipo Agua. Desaparece tras usarlo.
absorb-bulb.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Atk if the holder is hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.

cell-battery.name: Cell Battery
cell-battery.flavor_text_es: Batería de usar y tirar que sube el Ataque de quien la lleva cuando recibe un golpe de tipo Eléctrico.
cell-battery.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if the holder is hit with an Electric-type attack. It can only be used once.

eject-button.name: Eject Button
eject-button.flavor_text_es: Si el portador es alcanzado por un ataque, saldrá del combate y será sustituido por otro Pokémon del equipo.
eject-button.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit by an attack, it will be switched out of battle.

fire-gem.name: Fire Gem
fire-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fire-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of fire. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fire-type move one time.

water-gem.name: Water Gem
water-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Agua. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
water-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move one time.

electric-gem.name: Electric Gem
electric-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
electric-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of electricity. When held, it strengthens the power of an Electric-type move one time.

grass-gem.name: Grass Gem
grass-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Planta. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
grass-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of nature. When held, it strengthens the power of a Grass-type move one time.

ice-gem.name: Ice Gem
ice-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hielo. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
ice-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of ice. When held, it strengthens the power of an Ice-type move one time.

fighting-gem.name: Fighting Gem
fighting-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Lucha. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fighting-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of combat. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fighting-type move one time.

poison-gem.name: Poison Gem
poison-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Veneno. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
poison-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of poison. When held, it strengthens the power of a Poison-type move one time.

ground-gem.name: Ground Gem
ground-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
ground-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of land. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ground-type move one time.

flying-gem.name: Flying Gem
flying-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Volador. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
flying-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of air. When held, it strengthens the power of a Flying-type move one time.

psychic-gem.name: Psychic Gem
psychic-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Psíquico. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
psychic-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of the mind. When held, it strengthens the power of a Psychic-type move one time.

bug-gem.name: Bug Gem
bug-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Bicho. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
bug-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an insect-like essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Bug-type move one time.

rock-gem.name: Rock Gem
rock-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Roca. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
rock-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of rock. When held, it strengthens the power of a Rock-type move one time.

ghost-gem.name: Ghost Gem
ghost-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fantasma. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
ghost-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with a spectral essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ghost-type move one time.

dark-gem.name: Dark Gem
dark-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Siniestro. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
dark-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of darkness. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dark-type move one time.

steel-gem.name: Steel Gem
steel-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
steel-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of steel. When held, it strengthens the power of a Steel-type move one time.

health-wing.name: Health Feather
health-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco los PS de base de un Pokémon.
health-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the HP base points of a single Pokémon.

muscle-wing.name: Muscle Feather
muscle-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco el Ataque de base de un Pokémon.
muscle-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Attack base points of a single Pokémon.

resist-wing.name: Resist Feather
resist-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco la Defensa de base de un Pokémon.
resist-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Defense base points of a single Pokémon.

genius-wing.name: Genius Feather
genius-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco el Ataque Especial de base de un Pokémon.
genius-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Sp. Atk base points of a single Pokémon.

clever-wing.name: Clever Feather
clever-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco la Defensa Especial de base de un Pokémon.
clever-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Sp. Def base points of a single Pokémon.

swift-wing.name: Swift Feather
swift-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma que aumenta un poco la Velocidad de base de un Pokémon.
swift-wing.flavor_text_en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Speed base points of a single Pokémon.

pretty-wing.name: Pretty Feather
pretty-wing.flavor_text_es: Pluma normal y corriente. Muy bonita, pero no sirve para nada.
pretty-wing.flavor_text_en: Though this feather is beautiful, it’s just a regular feather and has no effect.

cover-fossil.name: Cover Fossil
cover-fossil.flavor_text_es: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser un fragmento de caparazón.
cover-fossil.flavor_text_en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It appears as though it could be part of its back.

plume-fossil.name: Plume Fossil
plume-fossil.flavor_text_es: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que surcaba los cielos. Parece ser parte de una de sus alas.
plume-fossil.flavor_text_en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sky. It looks as if it could come from part of its wing.

liberty-pass.name: Liberty Pass
liberty-pass.flavor_text_es: Ticket especial para ir en barco desde Ciudad Porcelana a Isla Libertad.
liberty-pass.flavor_text_en: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.

pass-orb.name: Pass Orb
pass-orb.flavor_text_es: Esfera misteriosa que contiene el poder de la región de Teselia y se utiliza para generar Poderes Regalo.
pass-orb.flavor_text_en: A mysterious orb containing the power of the Unova region, to be used when generating Pass Power.

dream-ball.name: Dream Ball
dream-ball.flavor_text_es: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con los Pokémon dormidos.
dream-ball.flavor_text_en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they’re asleep.

poke-toy.name: Poké Toy
poke-toy.flavor_text_es: Un objeto que atrae a los Pokémon. Es útil para huir de un combate contra un Pokémon salvaje.
poke-toy.flavor_text_en: A toy that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.

prop-case.name: Prop Case
prop-case.flavor_text_es: Una bonita cajita donde guardar todos los Complementos para vestir a tus Pokémon en el Teatro Musical.
prop-case.flavor_text_en: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

dragon-skull.name: Dragon Skull
dragon-skull.flavor_text_es: Cráneo de un Pokémon. Se dice que este Pokémon cruzó mares embravecidos.
dragon-skull.flavor_text_en: A skull of a Pokémon that was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.

balm-mushroom.name: Balm Mushroom
balm-mushroom.flavor_text_es: Extraña seta que desprende un agradable aroma. Puede alcanzar un alto precio en las tiendas.
balm-mushroom.flavor_text_en: A rare mushroom that gives off a nice fragrance. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

big-nugget.name: Big Nugget
big-nugget.flavor_text_es: Pepita grande de oro puro que desprende un brillo espectacular. Puede venderse a un precio muy alto en las tiendas.
big-nugget.flavor_text_en: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

pearl-string.name: Pearl String
pearl-string.flavor_text_es: Brillantes perlas plateadas de gran tamaño que pueden venderse a buen precio en las tiendas.
pearl-string.flavor_text_en: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. They can be sold at a high price to shops.

comet-shard.name: Comet Shard
comet-shard.flavor_text_es: Fragmento de un cometa caído al suelo al atravesar la atmósfera. Se puede vender a buen precio en las tiendas.
comet-shard.flavor_text_en: A shard that fell to the ground when a comet approached. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

relic-copper.name: Relic Copper
relic-copper.flavor_text_es: Moneda de cobre de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-copper.flavor_text_en: A copper coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-silver.name: Relic Silver
relic-silver.flavor_text_es: Moneda de plata de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-silver.flavor_text_en: A silver coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-gold.name: Relic Gold
relic-gold.flavor_text_es: Moneda de oro de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-gold.flavor_text_en: A gold coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-vase.name: Relic Vase
relic-vase.flavor_text_es: Jarrón de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-vase.flavor_text_en: A fragile vase made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-band.name: Relic Band
relic-band.flavor_text_es: Brazalete de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-band.flavor_text_en: A heavy bracelet made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-statue.name: Relic Statue
relic-statue.flavor_text_es: Efigie de piedra de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-statue.flavor_text_en: A stone figurine made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-crown.name: Relic Crown
relic-crown.flavor_text_es: Corona de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-crown.flavor_text_en: A heavy crown made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

casteliacone.name: Casteliacone
casteliacone.flavor_text_es: Especialidad de Ciudad Porcelana. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
casteliacone.flavor_text_en: Castelia City’s specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

dire-hit-2.name: Dire Hit 2
dire-hit-2.flavor_text_es: Aumenta la probabilidad de asestar un golpe crítico. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
dire-hit-2.flavor_text_en: It can be used many times to raise the critical-hit ratio of one Pokémon. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-speed-2.name: X Speed 2
x-speed-2.flavor_text_es: Aumenta ligeramente la Velocidad en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-speed-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-sp-atk-2.name: X Sp. Atk 2
x-sp-atk-2.flavor_text_es: Aumenta ligeramente el Ataque Especial en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-sp-atk-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-sp-def-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-defense-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-attack-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-accuracy-2.name: X Accuracy 2

x-accuracy-2.flavor_text_en: It sharply raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-speed-3.flavor_text_es: Aumenta bastante la Velocidad en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.

x-accuracy-3.flavor_text_en: It drastically raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-speed-6.flavor_text_es: Aumenta mucho la Velocidad en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-speed-6.flavor_text_en: It raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-accuracy-6.flavor_text_en: It raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

ability-urge.name: Ability Urge
ability-urge.flavor_text_es: Al usarlo, activa la habilidad de un Pokémon de tu equipo.
ability-urge.flavor_text_en: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.

item-drop.name: Item Drop
item-drop.flavor_text_es: Cuando se usa, un Pokémon de tu equipo pierde su objeto.
item-drop.flavor_text_en: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.

item-urge.name: Item Urge
item-urge.flavor_text_es: Cuando se usa, un Pokémon de tu equipo utiliza su objeto inmediatamente.
item-urge.flavor_text_en: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.

reset-urge.name: Reset Urge
reset-urge.flavor_text_es: Cuando se usa, se anulan los cambios en las características de un Pokémon de tu equipo.
reset-urge.flavor_text_en: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.

dire-hit-3.name: Dire Hit 3
dire-hit-3.flavor_text_es: Aumenta mucho la probabilidad de asestar un golpe crítico. Al cambiar de Pokémon, su efecto desaparece.
dire-hit-3.flavor_text_en: It can be used many times to greatly raise a Pokémon’s critical-hit ratio. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

light-stone.name: Light Stone
light-stone.flavor_text_es: Forma que adoptó Reshiram al perder su cuerpo. Espera la llegada de un nuevo héroe.
light-stone.flavor_text_en: Reshiram’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

dark-stone.name: Dark Stone
dark-stone.flavor_text_es: Forma que adoptó Zekrom al perder su cuerpo. Espera la llegada de un nuevo héroe.
dark-stone.flavor_text_en: Zekrom’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.

tm93.name: TM93
tm93.flavor_text_es: El usuario irradia unas raras ondas que, al alcanzar a un oponente, hacen que disminuya mucho su Ataque Especial.
tm93.flavor_text_en: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

tm94.name: TM94
tm94.flavor_text_es: Ataque moderado que no debilita al objetivo y le deja al menos 1 PS.
tm94.flavor_text_en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tm95.name: TM95
tm95.flavor_text_es: Ataca con un viento afilado que incluso corta el aire. También puede amedrentar al objetivo.
tm95.flavor_text_en: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

xtransceiver.name: Xtransceiver
xtransceiver.flavor_text_es: Comunicador de alta tecnología con cámara que permite hablar a cuatro personas a la vez.
xtransceiver.flavor_text_en: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.

god-stone.name: god stone
god-stone.flavor_text_es: Este aparato permite recibir vídeos holográficos y visualizarlos en cualquier momento.

gram-1.name: Gram 1
gram-1.flavor_text_en: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

gram-2.name: Gram 2
gram-2.flavor_text_en: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

gram-3.name: Gram 3
gram-3.flavor_text_en: An important letter that Wingull delivers.

dragon-gem.name: Dragon Gem
dragon-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
dragon-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with a draconic essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dragon-type move one time.

normal-gem.name: Normal Gem
normal-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Normal. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
normal-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an ordinary essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Normal-type move one time.

medal-box.name: Medal Box
medal-box.flavor_text_es: Un dispositivo con forma de caja que almacena las insignias y la información relacionada.
medal-box.flavor_text_en: A box-shaped machine that stores Medals and Medal information.

dna-splicers.name: DNA Splicers
dna-splicers.flavor_text_es: Punta que permite fusionar a Kyurem con cierto Pokémon con el que, originariamente, formaba un solo ser.
dna-splicers.flavor_text_en: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

permit.name: Permit
permit.flavor_text_es: Permiso necesario para acceder a la Reserva Natural, lugar que solo unos pocos conocen.
permit.flavor_text_en: A permit that is needed to enter the Nature Preserve. Not many know about it.

oval-charm.name: Oval Charm
oval-charm.flavor_text_es: Misterioso amuleto ovalado que aumenta la posibilidad de encontrar Huevos en Cuidados Pokémon.
oval-charm.flavor_text_en: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Pokémon Eggs being found at the Nursery.

shiny-charm.name: Shiny Charm
shiny-charm.flavor_text_es: Misterioso amuleto brillante que aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon variocolor.
shiny-charm.flavor_text_en: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon in the wild.

plasma-card.name: Plasma Card
plasma-card.flavor_text_es: Tarjeta necesaria para introducir la contraseña en la Fragata Plasma.
plasma-card.flavor_text_en: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.

grubby-hanky.name: Grubby Hanky
grubby-hanky.flavor_text_es: Pañuelo perdido por un cliente habitual del Café Alma en Ciudad Esmalte. Desprende el olor de un Pokémon.
grubby-hanky.flavor_text_en: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Café Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.

colress-machine.name: Colress Machine
colress-machine.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo que permite aumentar forzadamente las características de los Pokémon. Es un prototipo imperfecto.
colress-machine.flavor_text_en: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokémon. It’s an imperfect prototype.

dropped-item.name: Dropped Item
dropped-item.flavor_text_es: Videomisor encontrado en el parque de atracciones de Ciudad Mayólica. Parece que pertenece a un chico.
dropped-item.flavor_text_en: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.

reveal-glass.name: Reveal Glass
reveal-glass.flavor_text_es: Espejo misterioso que refleja la verdad y devuelve los Pokémon a su forma original.
reveal-glass.flavor_text_en: A looking glass that reveals the truth. It’s a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon to its original shape.

weakness-policy.name: Weakness Policy
weakness-policy.flavor_text_es: Aumenta mucho el Ataque y el Ataque Especial cuando el Pokémon que lo lleva recibe un ataque frente al cual es débil.
weakness-policy.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it’s weak to.

assault-vest.name: Assault Vest
assault-vest.flavor_text_es: Chaleco que potencia la Defensa Especial del Pokémon que lo lleva, pero le impide lanzar movimientos de estado.
assault-vest.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This offensive vest raises Sp. Def but prevents the use of status moves.

pixie-plate.name: Pixie Plate
pixie-plate.flavor_text_es: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hada. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
pixie-plate.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fairy-type moves.

ability-capsule.name: Ability Capsule
ability-capsule.flavor_text_es: Cápsula que les permite cambiar de habilidad a los Pokémon que poseen dos.
ability-capsule.flavor_text_en: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.

whipped-dream.name: Whipped Dream
whipped-dream.flavor_text_es: Un dulce a base de suave y esponjosa nata montada. A cierto Pokémon le encanta.
whipped-dream.flavor_text_en: A soft and sweet treat made of fluffy, puffy, whipped, and whirled cream. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

sachet.name: Sachet
sachet.flavor_text_es: Un saquito lleno de sustancias aromáticas cuyo perfume resulta abrumador, pero que a cierto Pokémon le encanta.
sachet.flavor_text_en: A sachet filled with fragrant perfumes that are just slightly too overwhelming. Yet it’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

luminous-moss.name: Luminous Moss
luminous-moss.flavor_text_es: Objeto de un solo uso. Aumenta la Defensa Especial del Pokémon que lo lleva si este recibe un ataque de tipo Agua.
luminous-moss.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def if the holder is hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.

snowball.name: Snowball
snowball.flavor_text_es: Objeto de un solo uso. Aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon que lo lleva si este recibe un ataque de tipo Hielo.
snowball.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if the holder is hit with an Ice-type attack. It can only be used once.

safety-goggles.name: Safety Goggles
safety-goggles.flavor_text_es: Gafa que protege de los efectos adversos del clima y del polvo lanzado por los rivales.
safety-goggles.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These goggles protect the holder from both weather-related damage and powder.

rich-mulch.name: Rich Mulch
rich-mulch.flavor_text_es: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
rich-mulch.flavor_text_en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.

surprise-mulch.name: Surprise Mulch
surprise-mulch.flavor_text_es: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
surprise-mulch.flavor_text_en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.

amaze-mulch.name: Amaze Mulch
amaze-mulch.flavor_text_es: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
amaze-mulch.flavor_text_en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.

gengarite.name: Gengarite
gengarite.flavor_text_es: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Gengar en combate.
gengarite.flavor_text_en: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Gengar hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
