garchompite.flavor_text_en: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Garchomp hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

kee-berry.name: Kee Berry
kee-berry.flavor_text_es: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta su Defensa tras recibir un ataque físico.
kee-berry.flavor_text_en: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder’s Defense if it’s hit with a physical move.

maranga-berry.name: Maranga Berry
maranga-berry.flavor_text_es: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta su Defensa Especial tras recibir un ataque especial.
maranga-berry.flavor_text_en: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder’s Sp. Def if it’s hit with a special move.

discount-coupon.name: Discount Coupon
discount-coupon.flavor_text_es: Con este vale te harán jugosos descuentos cuando vayas de compras a una boutique.
discount-coupon.flavor_text_en: This special coupon allows you to buy items at a discount when you are shopping at a boutique.

strange-souvenir.name: Strange Souvenir
strange-souvenir.flavor_text_es: Ornamento que representa a un Pokémon misterioso venerado desde la antigüedad en Alola como espíritu protector.
strange-souvenir.flavor_text_en: An ornament depicting a mysterious Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity for an extremely long time in the Alola region.

lumiose-galette.name: Lumiose Galette
lumiose-galette.flavor_text_es: El dulce estrella de Ciudad Luminalia. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
lumiose-galette.flavor_text_en: A popular treat in Lumiose City. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

jaw-fossil.name: Jaw Fossil
jaw-fossil.flavor_text_es: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece ser parte de una mandíbula.
jaw-fossil.flavor_text_en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks as if it could be a piece of a large jaw.

sail-fossil.name: Sail Fossil
sail-fossil.flavor_text_es: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece la impresión de una aleta.
sail-fossil.flavor_text_en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks like the impression from a skin sail.

fairy-gem.name: Fairy Gem
fairy-gem.flavor_text_es: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hada. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fairy-gem.flavor_text_en: A gem with an essence of the fey. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fairy-type move one time.

adventure-rules.name: Adventure Guide
adventure-rules.flavor_text_es: Pequeño dispositivo que va añadiendo y compilando de forma automática consejos y pistas útiles para la aventura de todo Entrenador.
adventure-rules.flavor_text_en: A compact device that automatically collects and records advice when a Trainer is out on an adventure.

elevator-key.name: Elevator Key
elevator-key.flavor_text_es: Tarjeta con el logotipo del Team Flare que activa el ascensor de los Laboratorios Lysson.
elevator-key.flavor_text_en: A card key that activates the elevator in Lysandre Labs. It is emblazoned with Team Flare’s logo.

holo-caster.name: Holo Caster
holo-caster.flavor_text_es: Este aparato permite recibir vídeos holográficos y visualizarlos en cualquier momento.
holo-caster.flavor_text_en: A device that allows users to receive and view hologram clips at any time. It’s also used to chat with others.

honor-of-kalos.name: Honor of Kalos
honor-of-kalos.flavor_text_es: Símbolo otorgado en reconocimiento a quienes han realizado gestas excepcionales en la región de Kalos.
honor-of-kalos.flavor_text_en: A precious symbol that is awarded only to an individual who has done great things for the Kalos region.

intriguing-stone.name: Intriguing Stone
intriguing-stone.flavor_text_es: Una curiosa piedra que a algunos les puede parecer de gran valor.
intriguing-stone.flavor_text_en: A rather curious stone that might appear valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.

lens-case.name: Lens Case
lens-case.flavor_text_es: Estuche de aspecto sofisticado para llevar tus lentes de contacto.
lens-case.flavor_text_en: A rather chic-looking case for carrying contact lenses.

looker-ticket.name: Looker Ticket
looker-ticket.flavor_text_es: Boleto hecho a mano por Handsome, decorado con una generosa cantidad de purpurina.
looker-ticket.flavor_text_en: A ticket that was handmade by Looker. It’s decorated with a liberal amount of glittery paint.

mega-ring.name: Mega Ring
mega-ring.flavor_text_es: Accesorio con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-ring.flavor_text_en: This ring contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.

power-plant-pass.name: Power Plant Pass
power-plant-pass.flavor_text_es: Documento de identificación necesario para acceder a la central eléctrica de la Ruta 13.
power-plant-pass.flavor_text_en: This pass serves as an ID card for gaining access to the Power Plant that lies along Route 13.

profs-letter.name: Prof’s Letter
profs-letter.flavor_text_es: Una carta sutilmente perfumada que el Profesor Ciprés le ha escrito a tu madre.
profs-letter.flavor_text_en: A letter that Professor Sycamore wrote to your mother. A faint but pleasant perfume seems to cling to the paper.

roller-skates.name: Roller Skates
roller-skates.flavor_text_es: Ruedas que se acoplan a la suela del calzado y te permiten ir más rápido y realizar piruetas espectaculares.
roller-skates.flavor_text_en: Attaches roller skates to the bottom of your shoes, allowing you to glide quickly around and perform tricks.

sprinklotad.name: Sprinklotad
sprinklotad.flavor_text_es: Una regadera con forma de Lotad. Ayuda a que las bayas plantadas en suelo blandito crezcan mejor.
sprinklotad.flavor_text_en: A watering can shaped like a Lotad. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

tmv-pass.name: TMV Pass
tmv-pass.flavor_text_es: Pase que permite realizar viajes ilimitados en el TMV que une las ciudades de Luminalia y Batik.
tmv-pass.flavor_text_en: A commuter pass that allows the holder to ride the TMV between Lumiose City and Kiloude City at any time.

tm96.name: TM96
tm96.flavor_text_es: El usuario ensarta al adversario con su afilada cornamenta. Este movimiento acierta siempre.
tm96.flavor_text_en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

tm97.name: TM97
tm97.flavor_text_es: Hace pivotar su cuerpo para causar daño a su alrededor.
tm97.flavor_text_en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

tm98.name: TM98
tm98.flavor_text_es: Usa la frustración como revulsivo para atacar. La potencia de Pataleta se duplica si el usuario ha fallado el último movimiento usado.
tm98.flavor_text_en: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

tm99.name: TM99
tm99.flavor_text_es: El usuario sacude violentamente su enorme cola para golpear a todos los rivales y reducir su Ataque a la par.
tm99.flavor_text_en: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

tm100.name: TM100
tm100.flavor_text_es: Hace que el objetivo pierda la concentración contándole un secreto. Disminuye el Ataque Especial del oponente.
tm100.flavor_text_en: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

latiasite.name: Latiasite
latiasite.flavor_text_es: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Latias en combate.
latiasite.flavor_text_en: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Latias hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

latiosite.name: Latiosite
latiosite.flavor_text_es: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Latios en combate.
latiosite.flavor_text_en: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Latios hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

common-stone.name: Common Stone
common-stone.flavor_text_es: Una piedra de aspecto normal que a algunos les puede parecer de gran valor.
common-stone.flavor_text_en: A perfectly normal stone that might appear to be valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.

makeup-bag.name: Makeup Bag
makeup-bag.flavor_text_es: Neceser de aspecto sofisticado para guardar tus barras de labios.
makeup-bag.flavor_text_en: A rather chic-looking case for carrying lipsticks.

travel-trunk.name: Travel Trunk
travel-trunk.flavor_text_es: Maleta ligera de increíble capacidad donde podrás guardar todas las prendas de ropa que quieras.
travel-trunk.flavor_text_en: A light and yet incredibly effective trunk, which can contain every last piece of clothing that can be bought.

shalour-sable.name: Shalour Sable
shalour-sable.flavor_text_es: Especialidad de Ciudad Yantra. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
shalour-sable.flavor_text_en: Shalour City’s famous shortbread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

mega-charm.name: Mega Charm
mega-charm.flavor_text_es: Amuleto con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-charm.flavor_text_en: This charm contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.

mega-glove.name: Mega Glove
mega-glove.flavor_text_es: Guante con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-glove.flavor_text_en: This glove contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.

devon-parts.name: Devon Parts
devon-parts.flavor_text_es: Contiene piezas de algo fabricado por Devon S. A.
devon-parts.flavor_text_en: A case that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the Devon Corporation.

pokeblock-kit.name: Pokéblock Kit
pokeblock-kit.flavor_text_es: Kit consistente en una Licuabayas para preparar Pokécubos a partir de bayas y un Tubo Pokécubos para guardarlos.
pokeblock-kit.flavor_text_en: A set containing a Berry Blender for making Pokéblocks and a Pokéblock Case for storing Pokéblocks.

key-to-room-1.name: Key to Room 1
key-to-room-1.flavor_text_es: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-1.flavor_text_en: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-2.name: Key to Room 2
key-to-room-2.flavor_text_es: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-2.flavor_text_en: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-4.name: Key to Room 4
key-to-room-4.flavor_text_es: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-4.flavor_text_en: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-6.name: Key to Room 6
key-to-room-6.flavor_text_es: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-6.flavor_text_en: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

devon-scuba-gear.name: Devon Scuba Gear
devon-scuba-gear.flavor_text_es: Máscara que surte de oxígeno durante las inmersiones en el agua. Producto de Devon S. A.
devon-scuba-gear.flavor_text_en: A device made by Devon Corporation that provides oxygen to users during the use of Dive.

contest-costume--jacket.name: Contest Costume
contest-costume--jacket.flavor_text_es: Traje de lo más espectacular para lucir en el Gran Concurso.
contest-costume--jacket.flavor_text_en: A very cool suit to be worn during the Contest Spectacular.

magma-suit.name: Magma Suit
magma-suit.flavor_text_es: Este traje es el resultado de las arduas investigaciones científicas del Equipo Magma. Es capaz de soportar cualquier impacto.
magma-suit.flavor_text_en: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Magma. It can withstand any impact.

aqua-suit.name: Aqua Suit
aqua-suit.flavor_text_es: Este traje es el resultado de las arduas investigaciones científicas del Equipo Aqua. Es capaz de soportar cualquier impacto.
aqua-suit.flavor_text_en: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Aqua. It can withstand any impact.

pair-of-tickets.name: Pair of Tickets
pair-of-tickets.flavor_text_es: Pase de dos personas para asistir al espectáculo de astronomía que se celebra en el Centro Espacial de Algaria.
pair-of-tickets.flavor_text_en: Tickets for two to the astronomical show being held at the Mossdeep Space Center.

key-stone.flavor_text_en: A stone filled with an unexplained power. It makes Pokémon that battle with a Mega Stone Mega Evolve.

meteorite-shard.name: Meteorite Shard
meteorite-shard.flavor_text_es: Trozo de meteorito encontrado en el suelo de la Cueva Granito. Es ligeramente cálido al tacto.
meteorite-shard.flavor_text_en: One of the fragments of a Meteorite from Granite Cave. It’s faintly warm to the touch.

eon-flute.name: Eon Flute
eon-flute.flavor_text_es: Flauta capaz de invocar a Latios o Latias en cualquier lugar.
eon-flute.flavor_text_en: A flute that can be used to summon Latios or Latias no matter where you are.

bottle-cap.name: Bottle Cap
bottle-cap.flavor_text_es: Una bonita chapa de color plata. Hay gente que las aprecia mucho.
bottle-cap.flavor_text_en: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.

gold-bottle-cap.name: Gold Bottle Cap
gold-bottle-cap.flavor_text_es: Una bonita chapa de color dorado, menos común que su equivalente plateada. Hay gente que las aprecia mucho.
gold-bottle-cap.flavor_text_en: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a golden gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.

z-ring.name: Z-Ring
z-ring.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa pulsera que transmite la fuerza física y mental del Entrenador a sus Pokémon, lo que les permite usar movimientos Z.
z-ring.flavor_text_en: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.

decidium-z--held.name: Decidium Z

tapunium-z--held.name: Tapunium Z

tapunium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades the tapu’s Nature’s Madness to a Z-Move.

aloraichium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Alolan Raichu’s Thunderbolt to a Z-Move.

snorlium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Snorlax’s Giga Impact to a Z-Move.

eevium-z--held.name: Eevium Z

eevium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Eevee’s Last Resort to a Z-Move.

mewnium-z--held.name: Mewnium Z
mewnium-z--held.flavor_text_es: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Psíquico de Mew.
mewnium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Mew’s Psychic to a Z-Move.

pikashunium-z--held.name: Pikashunium Z
pikashunium-z--held.flavor_text_es: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Rayo de los Pikachu que llevan gorra.
pikashunium-z--held.flavor_text_en: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades a Thunderbolt by Pikachu in a cap to a Z-Move.

forage-bag.name: Forage Bag
forage-bag.flavor_text_es: Saco para guardar ingredientes, indispensable en la Jungla Umbría para superar la prueba de Lulú.
forage-bag.flavor_text_en: A bag to carry ingredients gathered during Mallow’s trial in the jungle.

fishing-rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing-rod.flavor_text_es: Caña fabricada por la Capitana Nereida. Permite pescar los Pokémon escondidos en las rocas sumergidas.
fishing-rod.flavor_text_en: A fishing rod made by Captain Lana. Cast a line over piles of underwater rocks to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

professors-mask.name: Professor’s Mask
professors-mask.flavor_text_es: La máscara de luchador de Royale, el Enmascarado. Muy probablemente de factura propia.
professors-mask.flavor_text_en: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal. This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.

festival-ticket.name: Festival Ticket
festival-ticket.flavor_text_es: Se puede canjear para organizar minijuegos en la Festi Plaza.
festival-ticket.flavor_text_en: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.

sparkling-stone.name: Sparkling Stone
sparkling-stone.flavor_text_es: Piedra con un misterioso brillo entregada por un Pokémon considerado como uno de los espíritus guardianes de Alola.
sparkling-stone.flavor_text_en: A stone entrusted by a Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.

adrenaline-orb.name: Adrenaline Orb
adrenaline-orb.flavor_text_es: Aumenta la Velocidad del portador si se siente intimidado.
adrenaline-orb.flavor_text_en: If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated.

zygarde-cube.name: Zygarde Cube
zygarde-cube.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo en el que se hallan almacenados núcleos y células de Zygarde. También le permite cambiar de forma.
zygarde-cube.flavor_text_en: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde’s forms.

ice-stone.name: Ice Stone
ice-stone.flavor_text_es: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Presenta motivos que recuerdan a los cristales de hielo.
ice-stone.flavor_text_en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.

ride-pager.name: Ride Pager
ride-pager.flavor_text_es: Dispositivo dotado de un teclado numérico con el que llamar a diversas Pokémonturas.
ride-pager.flavor_text_en: By entering certain numbers on this pager, you can summon Ride Pokémon in an instant.

beast-ball.name: Beast Ball
beast-ball.flavor_text_es: Un tipo especial de Poké Ball con la que resulta difícil atrapar Pokémon.
beast-ball.flavor_text_en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that has a low success rate for catching a Pokémon.

big-malasada.name: Big Malasada
big-malasada.flavor_text_es: Fritura típica de Alola que cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
big-malasada.flavor_text_en: The Alola region’s local specialty—fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

red-nectar.name: Red Nectar
red-nectar.flavor_text_es: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Ula-Ula, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
red-nectar.flavor_text_en: A flower nectar obtained at Ula’ula Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

yellow-nectar.name: Yellow Nectar
yellow-nectar.flavor_text_es: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Melemele, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
yellow-nectar.flavor_text_en: A flower nectar obtained at Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

pink-nectar.name: Pink Nectar
pink-nectar.flavor_text_es: Néctar de ciertas flores de los parterres de la Avenida Royale, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
pink-nectar.flavor_text_en: A flower nectar obtained from the flowering shrubs on Royal Avenue. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

purple-nectar.name: Purple Nectar
purple-nectar.flavor_text_es: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Poni, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
purple-nectar.flavor_text_en: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

sun-flute.name: Sun Flute
sun-flute.flavor_text_es: Flauta que se hace sonar como muestra de gratitud hacia el Pokémon legendario del sol.
sun-flute.flavor_text_en: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the sun.

moon-flute.name: Moon Flute
moon-flute.flavor_text_es: Flauta que se hace sonar como muestra de gratitud hacia el Pokémon legendario de la luna.
moon-flute.flavor_text_en: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the moon.

enigmatic-card.name: Enigmatic Card
enigmatic-card.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa nota que reza: "Te espero en una habitación del motel de la Ruta 8 en Akala".
enigmatic-card.flavor_text_en: A mysterious card. Written on it is a request for you to go to a guest room in an Akala motel on Route 8.

terrain-extender.name: Terrain Extender
terrain-extender.flavor_text_es: Al llevarlo, prolonga la duración de los campos creados por el Pokémon en el terreno de combate mediante movimientos o su habilidad.
terrain-extender.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the terrain caused by the holder’s move or Ability.

protective-pads.name: Protective Pads

kommonium-z--bag.flavor_text_es: Concentra el Poder Z en cristales que permiten a Kommo-o convertir su Fragor Escamas en un movimiento Z.
kommonium-z--bag.flavor_text_en: It converts Z-Power into crystals that upgrade Kommo-o’s Clanging Scales to an exclusive Z-Move.

z-power-ring.name: Z-Power Ring
z-power-ring.flavor_text_es: Misteriosa pulsera que transmite la fuerza física y mental del Entrenador a sus Pokémon, lo que les permite usar movimientos Z.
z-power-ring.flavor_text_en: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.

pink-petal.name: Pink Petal
pink-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Rika durante su prueba. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
pink-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mina during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

orange-petal.name: Orange Petal
orange-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Liam durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
orange-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Ilima during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

blue-petal.name: Blue Petal
blue-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Nereida durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
blue-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Lana during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

red-petal.name: Red Petal
red-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Kiawe durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
red-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Kiawe during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

green-petal.name: Green Petal
green-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Lulú durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
green-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mallow during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

yellow-petal.name: Yellow Petal
yellow-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Chris durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
yellow-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Sophocles during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

purple-petal.name: Purple Petal
purple-petal.flavor_text_es: Pétalo prensado recibido de manos de Denio durante la prueba de Rika. El objetivo es reunir siete distintos.
purple-petal.flavor_text_en: A pressed flower petal you receive from Nanu during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

rainbow-flower.name: Rainbow Flower
rainbow-flower.flavor_text_es: Flor resultante de la unión de los siete pétalos entregados por los Capitanes, símbolo de la experiencia y madurez acumuladas en tu aventura.
rainbow-flower.flavor_text_en: A flower made of the petals you received from captains. It’s proof that your growth has been recognized by them.

surge-badge.name: Surge Badge
surge-badge.flavor_text_es: Medalla conseguida en el Gimnasio de Kanto. Su aspecto guarda un sospechoso parecido con la medalla de otro gimnasio.
surge-badge.flavor_text_en: A novelty badge that you can receive at the Kantonian Gym. Rumor has it that it imitates the Badge of a Gym somewhere.

n-solarizer--merge.name: N-Solarizer
n-solarizer--merge.flavor_text_es: Artefacto que permite fusionar a Necrozma, ávido de luz, con Solgaleo.
n-solarizer--merge.flavor_text_en: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.

n-lunarizer--merge.name: N-Lunarizer
n-lunarizer--merge.flavor_text_es: Artefacto que permite fusionar a Necrozma, ávido de luz, con Lunala.
n-lunarizer--merge.flavor_text_en: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.

n-solarizer--split.name: N-Solarizer
n-solarizer--split.flavor_text_es: Artefacto que permite separar a Necrozma, ávido de luz, tras su fusión con Solgaleo.
n-solarizer--split.flavor_text_en: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Solgaleo.

n-lunarizer--split.name: N-Lunarizer
n-lunarizer--split.flavor_text_es: Artefacto que permite separar a Necrozma, ávido de luz, tras su fusión con Lunala.
n-lunarizer--split.flavor_text_en: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Lunala.

ilimas-normalium-z.name: Ilima Normalium Z
ilimas-normalium-z.flavor_text_es: Normastal Z que te entrega Liam para que lo deposites sobre el altar situado al fondo de la Cueva Sotobosque.
ilimas-normalium-z.flavor_text_en: The Normalium Z you were entrusted with by Ilima. You were asked to place it on the pedestal at the back of Verdant Cavern.

left-poke-ball.name: Left Poké Ball
left-poke-ball.flavor_text_es: Poké Ball que alberga un Pokémon que perdió a su Entrenador, al parecer, natural de Ula-Ula.
left-poke-ball.flavor_text_en: A Poké Ball with a Pokémon that lost its Trainer inside. It seems to be from Ula’ula Island.

roto-hatch.name: Roto Hatch
roto-hatch.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que hace que los Huevos eclosionen mucho antes.
roto-hatch.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It helps Eggs hatch faster.

roto-bargain.name: Roto Bargain
roto-bargain.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que reduce a la mitad el coste de los artículos en las Tiendas Pokémon.
roto-bargain.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It reduces the prices of products at Poké Marts by half.

roto-prize-money.name: Roto Prize Money
roto-prize-money.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que triplica las ganancias obtenidas en combate.
roto-prize-money.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It triples the prize money you receive after battle.

roto-exp-points.name: Roto Exp. Points
roto-exp-points.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que incrementa ligeramente los Puntos de Experiencia obtenidos en combate.
roto-exp-points.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the Exp. Points your Pokémon receive after battle a little.

roto-friendship.name: Roto Friendship
roto-friendship.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que hace que el grado de amistad de los Pokémon del equipo aumente más rápido.
roto-friendship.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It helps Pokémon in your party grow friendly faster.

roto-encounter.name: Roto Encounter
roto-encounter.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon salvajes de nivel alto durante un tiempo determinado.
roto-encounter.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the chance of encountering high-level wild Pokémon a lot for a certain period of time.

roto-stealth.name: Roto Stealth
roto-stealth.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que permite evitar por completo los encuentros con Pokémon salvajes durante un tiempo determinado.
roto-stealth.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It prevents you from encountering wild Pokémon for a certain period of time.

roto-hp-restore.name: Roto HP Restore
roto-hp-restore.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que restaura todos los PS de los Pokémon de tu equipo que estén combatiendo.
roto-hp-restore.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It fully restores the HP of your battling Pokémon.

roto-pp-restore.name: Roto PP Restore
roto-pp-restore.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que restaura todos los PP de los Pokémon de tu equipo que estén combatiendo.
roto-pp-restore.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It fully restores the PP of your battling Pokémon.

roto-boost.name: Roto Boost
roto-boost.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que hace aumentar las características de los Pokémon de tu equipo que estén combatiendo.
roto-boost.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It raises all stats of your battling Pokémon.

roto-catch.name: Roto Catch
roto-catch.flavor_text_es: Poder Rotom que aumenta mucho la probabilidad de capturar al Pokémon salvaje al que te estés enfrentando.
roto-catch.flavor_text_en: One of the Rotom Powers. It increases the chance to catch Pokémon a lot.

autograph.name: Autograph
autograph.flavor_text_es: El autógrafo del Teniente Surge, el Líder de Gimnasio de Ciudad Carmín. La dedicatoria reza: "Good luck!".
autograph.flavor_text_en: The autograph you got from the Vermilion City Gym Leader, Lt. Surge. He wrote, “Good luck!”

clothing-trunk.name: Clothing Trunk
clothing-trunk.flavor_text_es: Una maleta muy ligera en la que puedes guardar ropa o accesorios para ti o tu Pokémon.
clothing-trunk.flavor_text_en: A very light trunk that can carry clothing for you and your Pokémon.

silver-razz-berry.name: Silver Razz Berry
silver-razz-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para que resulte bastante más fácil capturarlo.
silver-razz-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that makes it easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

golden-razz-berry.name: Golden Razz Berry
golden-razz-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para que resulte mucho más fácil capturarlo.
golden-razz-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that makes it drastically easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

silver-nanab-berry.name: Silver Nanab Berry
silver-nanab-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para tranquilizarlo bastante.
silver-nanab-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that calms wild Pokémon you’re trying to catch when given to them.

golden-nanab-berry.name: Golden Nanab Berry
golden-nanab-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para tranquilizarlo mucho.
golden-nanab-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that calms wild Pokémon you’re trying to catch drastically when given to them.

silver-pinap-berry.name: Silver Pinap Berry
silver-pinap-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para aumentar bastante las probabilidades de conseguir un objeto tras capturarlo.
silver-pinap-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that makes you more likely to get an item when given to Pokémon you’re trying to catch.

golden-pinap-berry.name: Golden Pinap Berry
golden-pinap-berry.flavor_text_es: Una baya que puedes lanzar a un Pokémon salvaje para aumentar mucho las probabilidades de conseguir un objeto tras capturarlo.
golden-pinap-berry.flavor_text_en: A Berry that makes you drastically more likely to get an item when given to Pokémon you’re trying to catch.

secret-key--letsgo.name: Secret Key
secret-key--letsgo.flavor_text_es: Llave que abre las puertas del Gimnasio de Isla Canela. En su diseño predomina el color rojo.
secret-key--letsgo.flavor_text_en: The key that unlocks the front door of the Pokémon Gym on Cinnabar Island. It has a red decoration.

ss-ticket--letsgo.name: S.S. Ticket
ss-ticket--letsgo.flavor_text_es: Billete necesario para embarcar en el S. S. Anne. Tiene dibujado un barco.
ss-ticket--letsgo.flavor_text_en: The ticket required to board the S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

parcel--letsgo.name: Parcel
parcel--letsgo.flavor_text_es: Un paquete para el Profesor Oak que te entregaron en la Tienda Pokémon de Ciudad Verde.
parcel--letsgo.flavor_text_en: A parcel to be delivered to Professor Oak from Viridian City’s Poké Mart.

card-key--letsgo.name: Card Key
card-key--letsgo.flavor_text_es: Esta tarjeta permite abrir las puertas de la Oficina Central de Silph S. A. en Ciudad Azafrán.
card-key--letsgo.flavor_text_en: A card key that unlocks doors in Silph Co.’s head office in Saffron City.

stretchy-spring.name: Stretchy Spring
stretchy-spring.flavor_text_es: Muelle fino y pequeño. Está algo elongado y se desconoce cuál puede ser su uso.
stretchy-spring.flavor_text_en: A thin small spring. It’s totally stretched out, and what it’s used for is unknown.

chalky-stone.name: Chalky Stone
chalky-stone.flavor_text_es: Piedra de yeso pequeña y blanquecina encontrada en la linde de un camino.
chalky-stone.flavor_text_en: A small whitish stone picked up at the edge of the road.

marble.name: Marble
marble.flavor_text_es: Esfera de cristal transparente en cuyo interior se pueden apreciar diferentes colores.
marble.flavor_text_en: A round glass marble. You can see colored glass inside the transparent marble.

lone-earring.name: Lone Earring
lone-earring.flavor_text_es: Un pendiente que se le ha debido de caer a alguien.
lone-earring.flavor_text_en: A single earring that somebody dropped.

beach-glass.name: Beach Glass
beach-glass.flavor_text_es: Cristal de colores pulido por la acción erosiva de las olas. Al tacto resulta algo áspero.
beach-glass.flavor_text_en: A piece of colored glass. Waves have rounded its edges. It’s slightly rough to the touch.

gold-leaf.name: Gold Leaf
gold-leaf.flavor_text_es: Extraña hoja de color dorado. Se desconoce de qué árbol procede.
gold-leaf.flavor_text_en: A mysterious gold leaf. No trees with this leaf have been found yet.

silver-leaf.name: Silver Leaf
silver-leaf.flavor_text_es: Extraña hoja de color plateado. Se desconoce de qué árbol procede.
silver-leaf.flavor_text_en: A mysterious silver leaf. No trees with this leaf have been found yet.

polished-mud-ball.name: Polished Mud Ball
polished-mud-ball.flavor_text_es: Bola de barro que ha sido pulida durante tanto tiempo que su superficie ha quedado lisa y brillante.
polished-mud-ball.flavor_text_en: A ball made of mud. It had been polished for such a long time that the surface is very shiny.

tropical-shell.name: Tropical Shell
tropical-shell.flavor_text_es: Preciosa concha de color blanco que quizá haya sido arrastrada por las corrientes marinas desde mares de regiones más cálidas.
tropical-shell.flavor_text_en: A beautiful white shell that may have drifted from a sea in a warm region.

leaf-letter--pikachu.name: Leaf Letter
leaf-letter--pikachu.flavor_text_es: Una carta escrita en una hoja. Hay huellas de Pikachu estampadas en ella y parecen guardar algún significado.
leaf-letter--pikachu.flavor_text_en: A letter written on a leaf. Something is written using Pikachu’s footprints.

leaf-letter--eevee.name: Leaf Letter
leaf-letter--eevee.flavor_text_es: Una carta escrita en una hoja. Hay huellas de Eevee estampadas en ella y parecen guardar algún significado.
leaf-letter--eevee.flavor_text_en: A letter written on a leaf. Something is written using Eevee’s footprints.

small-bouquet.name: Small Bouquet
small-bouquet.flavor_text_es: Pequeño ramo de flores confeccionado con dedicación y esmero solo para ti.
small-bouquet.flavor_text_en: A small bouquet that was made with heart and soul for a single Trainer.

lure.name: Lure
lure.flavor_text_es: Colonia que atrae a los Pokémon raros durante un breve espacio de tiempo.
lure.flavor_text_en: A glass bottle of perfume that makes rare Pokémon more likely to appear.

super-lure.name: Super Lure
super-lure.flavor_text_es: Colonia que atrae a los Pokémon raros y cuyo efecto es algo más duradero que el de la Colonia.
super-lure.flavor_text_en: A glass bottle of perfume that makes rare Pokémon more likely to appear. It lasts longer than a Lure.

max-lure.name: Max Lure
max-lure.flavor_text_es: Colonia que atrae a los Pokémon raros y cuyo efecto es algo más duradero que el de la Supercolonia.
max-lure.flavor_text_en: A glass bottle of perfume that makes rare Pokémon more likely to appear. It lasts longer than a Super Lure.

pewter-crunchies.name: Pewter Crunchies
pewter-crunchies.flavor_text_es: Tentempié típico de Ciudad Plateada. Cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
pewter-crunchies.flavor_text_en: Pewter City’s famous crunchy snack. They can be used to heal all status conditions of a single Pokémon.

health-candy.name: Health Candy
health-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta los PS máximos del Pokémon.
health-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to a Pokémon, it will increase that Pokémon’s HP.

mighty-candy.name: Mighty Candy
mighty-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon.
mighty-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to a Pokémon, it will increase that Pokémon’s Attack stat.

tough-candy.name: Tough Candy
tough-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta la Defensa del Pokémon.
tough-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to a Pokémon, it will increase that Pokémon’s Defense stat.

smart-candy.name: Smart Candy
smart-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta el Ataque Especial del Pokémon.
smart-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to a Pokémon, it will increase that Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat.

courage-candy.name: Courage Candy
courage-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta la Defensa Especial del Pokémon.

quick-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to a Pokémon, it will increase that Pokémon’s Speed stat.

endorsement.name: Endorsement
endorsement.flavor_text_es: Una carta de recomendación necesaria para participar en el desafío de los gimnasios.
endorsement.flavor_text_en: A letter of recommendation that you’ll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.

pokemon-box-link.name: Pokémon Box Link
pokemon-box-link.flavor_text_es: Permite acceder en todo momento a tus Cajas del PC de los Centros Pokémon para dejar o sacar Pokémon.
pokemon-box-link.flavor_text_en: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.

wishing-star.name: Wishing Star
wishing-star.flavor_text_es: Piedra de poder misterioso hallada en la región de Galar. Se dice que quien encuentra una verá realizados sus sueños.
wishing-star.flavor_text_en: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.

dynamax-band.name: Dynamax Band
dynamax-band.flavor_text_es: Si lleva engarzada una Estrella Deseo y el portador se halla junto a un nodo energético, reacciona emitiendo una luz y permite dinamaxizar Pokémon.
dynamax-band.flavor_text_en: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

fishing-rod--galar.name: Fishing Rod
fishing-rod--galar.flavor_text_es: Sirve para pescar Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de cuerpos de agua.
fishing-rod--galar.flavor_text_en: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.

rotom-bike.name: Rotom Bike
rotom-bike.flavor_text_es: Una bicicleta en la que puede activarse el turbo, al llevar al Pokémon Rotom incorporado en el motor.
rotom-bike.flavor_text_en: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to use a turbo boost.

sausages.name: Sausages
sausages.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Si te apetece disfrutar de su delicioso sabor, basta con hervirlas.
sausages.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

bobs-food-tin.name: Bob’s Food Tin
bobs-food-tin.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Las conservas de Darren son muy apreciadas por todo Galar.
bobs-food-tin.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

bachs-food-tin.name: Bach’s Food Tin
bachs-food-tin.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Las conservas de Bach son muy apreciadas por todo Galar.
bachs-food-tin.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

tin-of-beans.name: Tin of Beans
tin-of-beans.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Al estofar las habas en la salsa, esta absorbe parte de su dulzor.
tin-of-beans.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.

bread.name: Bread
bread.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. No hay placer mayor que usar el pan para rebañar la salsa que queda en el plato.
bread.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

pasta.name: Pasta
pasta.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Estos fideos de harina de trigo combinan inesperadamente bien con el curri.
pasta.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.

mixed-mushrooms.name: Mixed Mushrooms
mixed-mushrooms.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Los distintos tipos de setas aportan diferentes texturas al curri.
mixed-mushrooms.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they’re added to.

smoke-poke-tail.name: Smoke-Poke Tail
smoke-poke-tail.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Las colas de Slowpoke siempre vuelven a crecer al poco de desprenderse.
smoke-poke-tail.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When a Slowpoke’s tail falls off, it grows back quickly.

large-leek.name: Large Leek
large-leek.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. No se sabe si este es el tipo de verdura que le gusta a Farfetch’d.
large-leek.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Whether this is the kind of vegetable stalk that Farfetch’d like is unknown.

fancy-apple.name: Fancy Apple
fancy-apple.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Es brillante y tiene una forma perfecta.
fancy-apple.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An apple chosen above others. It has spectacular form and a brilliant sheen.

brittle-bones.name: Brittle Bones
brittle-bones.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Los jugos del hueso dan un profundo sabor a la salsa.
brittle-bones.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.

pack-of-potatoes.name: Pack of Potatoes
pack-of-potatoes.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Las patatas contrarrestan el picante y suavizan el plato.
pack-of-potatoes.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.

pungent-root.name: Pungent Root
pungent-root.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Unas hierbas que aportan color y aroma a la salsa.
pungent-root.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.

salad-mix.name: Salad Mix
salad-mix.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Una mezcla muy sana de varios tipos de verduras.
salad-mix.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.

fried-food.name: Fried Food
fried-food.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. A medida que pasa el tiempo se van volviendo más aceitosas.
fried-food.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It’s been a while since it was fried, so it’s gotten greasy.

boiled-egg.name: Boiled Egg
boiled-egg.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Con tan solo uno de estos huevos se consigue un plato gourmet.
boiled-egg.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

camping-gear.name: Camping Gear
camping-gear.flavor_text_es: Este kit tiene todo lo necesario para montar una tienda de campaña y cocinar, ya sea en el Área Silvestre o en zonas de acampada.
camping-gear.flavor_text_en: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

rusted-sword.name: Rusted Sword
rusted-sword.flavor_text_es: Cuenta una antigua leyenda que un valiente héroe blandió esta espada para hacer frente a un cataclismo, pero ahora está oxidada y en un estado lamentable.
rusted-sword.flavor_text_en: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

rusted-shield.name: Rusted Shield
rusted-shield.flavor_text_es: Cuenta una antigua leyenda que un valiente héroe asió este escudo para hacer frente a un cataclismo, pero ahora está oxidado y en un estado lamentable.
rusted-shield.flavor_text_en: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

fossilized-bird.name: Fossilized Bird
fossilized-bird.flavor_text_es: Parte del fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que surcaba los cielos. Su apariencia sigue siendo una incógnita.
fossilized-bird.flavor_text_en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.

fossilized-fish.name: Fossilized Fish
fossilized-fish.flavor_text_es: Parte del fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que habitaba en el mar. Su apariencia sigue siendo una incógnita.
fossilized-fish.flavor_text_en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

fossilized-drake.name: Fossilized Drake
fossilized-drake.flavor_text_es: Parte del fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que habitaba en tierra firme. Su aspecto sigue siendo una incógnita.
fossilized-drake.flavor_text_en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.

fossilized-dino.name: Fossilized Dino
fossilized-dino.flavor_text_es: Parte del fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que habitaba en el mar. Su apariencia sigue siendo una incógnita.
fossilized-dino.flavor_text_en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

strawberry-sweet.name: Strawberry Sweet
strawberry-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de fresa. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
strawberry-sweet.flavor_text_en: A strawberry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it will spin around happily.

love-sweet.name: Love Sweet
love-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de corazón. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
love-sweet.flavor_text_en: A heart-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

berry-sweet.name: Berry Sweet
berry-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de baya. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
berry-sweet.flavor_text_en: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

clover-sweet.name: Clover Sweet
clover-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de trébol. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
clover-sweet.flavor_text_en: A clover-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

flower-sweet.name: Flower Sweet
flower-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de flor. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
flower-sweet.flavor_text_en: A flower-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

star-sweet.name: Star Sweet
star-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de estrella. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
star-sweet.flavor_text_en: A star-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

ribbon-sweet.name: Ribbon Sweet
ribbon-sweet.flavor_text_es: Figura de caramelo con forma de lazo. Al dárselo a Milcery, se pone a girar rebosante de alegría.
ribbon-sweet.flavor_text_en: A ribbon-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

sweet-apple.name: Sweet Apple
sweet-apple.flavor_text_es: Curiosa manzana, de sabor particularmente dulce, que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon.
sweet-apple.flavor_text_en: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally sweet.

tart-apple.name: Tart Apple
tart-apple.flavor_text_es: Curiosa manzana, de sabor particularmente ácido, que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon.
tart-apple.flavor_text_en: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally tart.

throat-spray.name: Throat Spray
throat-spray.flavor_text_es: Aumenta el Ataque Especial al emplear un movimiento que se sirva del sonido.
throat-spray.flavor_text_en: Raises Sp. Atk when a Pokémon uses a sound-based move.

eject-pack.name: Eject Pack
eject-pack.flavor_text_es: Si el portador ve reducidas sus características, será sustituido por otro Pokémon del equipo.
eject-pack.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder’s stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

heavy-duty-boots.name: Heavy-Duty Boots
heavy-duty-boots.flavor_text_es: Anula los efectos de aquello que se coloca a los pies del Pokémon para obstaculizarlo, como las trampas.
heavy-duty-boots.flavor_text_en: These boots prevent the effects of traps set on the battlefield.

blunder-policy.name: Blunder Policy
blunder-policy.flavor_text_es: Aumenta mucho la Velocidad cuando el Pokémon yerra el movimiento debido a la precisión.
blunder-policy.flavor_text_en: Raises Speed sharply when a Pokémon misses with a move because of accuracy.

room-service.name: Room Service
room-service.flavor_text_es: Si lo lleva un Pokémon, reduce la Velocidad cuando se usa Espacio Raro.
room-service.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Lowers Speed when Trick Room takes effect.

utility-umbrella.name: Utility Umbrella
utility-umbrella.flavor_text_es: El portador se vuelve invulnerable a los efectos de la lluvia y del sol.
utility-umbrella.flavor_text_en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

exp-candy-xs.name: Exp. Candy XS
exp-candy-xs.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta ligerísimamente los Puntos de Experiencia de un Pokémon.
exp-candy-xs.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

exp-candy-s.name: Exp. Candy S
exp-candy-s.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta ligeramente los Puntos de Experiencia de un Pokémon.
exp-candy-s.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

exp-candy-m.name: Exp. Candy M
exp-candy-m.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta los Puntos de Experiencia de un Pokémon.
exp-candy-m.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

exp-candy-l.name: Exp. Candy L
exp-candy-l.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta bastante los Puntos de Experiencia de un Pokémon.
exp-candy-l.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

exp-candy-xl.name: Exp. Candy XL
exp-candy-xl.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que aumenta mucho los Puntos de Experiencia de un Pokémon.
exp-candy-xl.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

dynamax-candy.name: Dynamax Candy
dynamax-candy.flavor_text_es: Caramelo energético que sube el nivel Dinamax de un Pokémon. Cuanto más alto sea el nivel, más aumentarán sus PS al dinamaxizarse.
dynamax-candy.flavor_text_en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will raise the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

tr00.name: TR00
tr00.flavor_text_es: Baile frenético que aumenta mucho el Ataque.
tr00.flavor_text_en: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tr01.name: TR01
tr01.flavor_text_es: Salta sobre el objetivo con todo su peso y puede llegar a paralizarlo.
tr01.flavor_text_en: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr02.name: TR02
tr02.flavor_text_es: Ataca con una gran ráfaga de fuego que puede causar quemaduras.
tr02.flavor_text_en: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr03.name: TR03
tr03.flavor_text_es: Lanza una gran masa de agua a presión para atacar.
tr03.flavor_text_en: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

tr04.name: TR04
tr04.flavor_text_es: Inunda el terreno de combate con una ola gigante.
tr04.flavor_text_en: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

tr05.name: TR05
tr05.flavor_text_es: Rayo de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.
tr05.flavor_text_en: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

tr06.name: TR06
tr06.flavor_text_es: Tormenta de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.
tr06.flavor_text_en: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

tr07.name: TR07
tr07.flavor_text_es: Patada baja que derriba al oponente. Cuanto más pesa el objetivo, más daño le causa.
tr07.flavor_text_en: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr08.name: TR08
tr08.flavor_text_es: Potente ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.
tr08.flavor_text_en: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr09.name: TR09
tr09.flavor_text_es: Un poderoso rayo que daña al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.
tr09.flavor_text_en: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr10.name: TR10
tr10.flavor_text_es: Un terremoto que afecta a todos los Pokémon que estén a su alrededor.
tr10.flavor_text_en: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

tr11.name: TR11
tr11.flavor_text_es: Fuerte ataque telequinético que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr11.flavor_text_en: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr12.name: TR12
tr12.flavor_text_es: Relaja el cuerpo para ganar mucha Velocidad.
tr12.flavor_text_en: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

tr13.name: TR13
tr13.flavor_text_es: Concentra energía para aumentar las posibilidades de asestar un golpe crítico.
tr13.flavor_text_en: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

tr14.name: TR14
tr14.flavor_text_es: Mueve un dedo y estimula su cerebro para usar al azar casi cualquier movimiento.
tr14.flavor_text_en: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

tr15.name: TR15
tr15.flavor_text_es: Llama intensa que chamusca y puede causar quemaduras.
tr15.flavor_text_en: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr16.name: TR16
tr16.flavor_text_es: Embiste con un gran impulso que puede llegar a amedrentar.
tr16.flavor_text_en: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

tr17.name: TR17
tr17.flavor_text_es: El usuario olvida sus preocupaciones y aumenta mucho la Defensa Especial.
tr17.flavor_text_en: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

tr18.name: TR18
tr18.flavor_text_es: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado al objetivo.
tr18.flavor_text_en: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tr19.name: TR19
tr19.flavor_text_es: Ataque triple que puede paralizar, quemar o congelar al objetivo.
tr19.flavor_text_en: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

tr20.name: TR20
tr20.flavor_text_es: Utiliza parte de los PS propios para crear un sustituto que actúa como señuelo.
tr20.flavor_text_en: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

tr21.name: TR21
tr21.flavor_text_es: Ataque desesperado que causa más daño cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario.
tr21.flavor_text_en: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

tr22.name: TR22
tr22.flavor_text_es: Arroja residuos al objetivo. Puede llegar a envenenar.
tr22.flavor_text_en: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

tr23.name: TR23
tr23.flavor_text_es: Esparce púas alrededor del equipo rival que hieren a los Pokémon rivales que entran en combate.
tr23.flavor_text_en: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr24.name: TR24
tr24.flavor_text_es: Ataca de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al agresor.
tr24.flavor_text_en: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

tr25.name: TR25
tr25.flavor_text_es: Crea una onda psíquica que causa daño físico al objetivo.
tr25.flavor_text_en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

tr26.name: TR26
tr26.flavor_text_es: Resiste cualquier ataque y deja al menos 1 PS. Puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
tr26.flavor_text_en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tr27.name: TR27
tr27.flavor_text_es: Mientras duerme, usa uno de sus movimientos elegido al azar.
tr27.flavor_text_en: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tr28.name: TR28
tr28.flavor_text_en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

tr29.name: TR29
tr29.flavor_text_es: Cambia el puesto con otro miembro del equipo y le pasa los cambios de características.
tr29.flavor_text_en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

tr30.name: TR30
tr30.flavor_text_es: El objetivo repite su último movimiento durante tres turnos.
tr30.flavor_text_en: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

tr31.name: TR31
tr31.flavor_text_es: Ataca con una cola férrea y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.
tr31.flavor_text_en: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr32.name: TR32
tr32.flavor_text_es: Tritura con afilados colmillos y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.
tr32.flavor_text_en: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr33.name: TR33
tr33.flavor_text_es: Lanza una bola oscura que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr33.flavor_text_en: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr34.name: TR34
tr34.flavor_text_es: Concentra energía psíquica para golpear al objetivo dos turnos después.
tr34.flavor_text_en: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

tr35.name: TR35
tr35.flavor_text_es: Ataca de forma alborotada durante tres turnos. Mantiene despiertos a todos.
tr35.flavor_text_en: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

tr36.name: TR36
tr36.flavor_text_es: Provoca un viento abrasador que puede quemar al objetivo.
tr36.flavor_text_en: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

tr37.name: TR37
tr37.flavor_text_es: Enfurece al objetivo para que solo use movimientos de ataque durante tres turnos.
tr37.flavor_text_en: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tr38.name: TR38
tr38.flavor_text_es: Engaña al objetivo desprevenido e intercambia objetos.
tr38.flavor_text_en: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

tr39.name: TR39
tr39.flavor_text_es: Ataque de gran potencia, pero que reduce el Ataque y la Defensa del agresor.
tr39.flavor_text_en: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

tr40.name: TR40
tr40.flavor_text_es: Usa el poder psíquico para intercambiar habilidades con el objetivo.
tr40.flavor_text_en: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

tr41.name: TR41
tr41.flavor_text_es: Patada que suele ser un golpe crítico y puede causar quemaduras.
tr41.flavor_text_en: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr42.name: TR42
tr42.flavor_text_es: Grito desgarrador que inflige daño al objetivo.
tr42.flavor_text_en: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

tr43.name: TR43
tr43.flavor_text_es: Ataque en toda regla que baja mucho el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.
tr43.flavor_text_en: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr44.name: TR44
tr44.flavor_text_es: Sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial propias con energía mística.
tr44.flavor_text_en: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr45.name: TR45
tr45.flavor_text_es: Ataque con agua lodosa que puede bajar la Precisión del equipo rival.
tr45.flavor_text_en: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

tr46.name: TR46
tr46.flavor_text_es: Fortalece el cuerpo como si fuera de hierro y sube mucho la Defensa.
tr46.flavor_text_en: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tr47.name: TR47
tr47.flavor_text_es: Araña al objetivo con garras afiladas.
tr47.flavor_text_en: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

tr48.name: TR48
tr48.flavor_text_es: Robustece el cuerpo para subir el Ataque y la Defensa.
tr48.flavor_text_en: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

tr49.name: TR49
tr49.flavor_text_es: Aumenta la concentración y calma el espíritu para subir el Ataque Especial y la Defensa Especial.
tr49.flavor_text_en: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tr50.name: TR50
tr50.flavor_text_es: Acuchilla con una hoja fina. Suele dar un golpe crítico.
tr50.flavor_text_en: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

tr51.name: TR51
tr51.flavor_text_es: Danza mística que sube el Ataque y la Velocidad.
tr51.flavor_text_en: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

tr52.name: TR52
tr52.flavor_text_es: Embiste al objetivo con un potente ataque giratorio. Cuanto más lento es el usuario, más daño causa.
tr52.flavor_text_en: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr53.name: TR53
tr53.flavor_text_es: Lucha abiertamente contra el objetivo sin protegerse. También reduce la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del usuario.
tr53.flavor_text_en: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr54.name: TR54
tr54.flavor_text_es: Lanza una trampa de púas tóxicas a los pies del objetivo. El veneno afecta a los Pokémon oponentes que entran en combate.
tr54.flavor_text_en: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr55.name: TR55
tr55.flavor_text_es: El Pokémon se cubre de llamas y carga contra el objetivo, aunque él también recibe daño. Puede quemar.
tr55.flavor_text_en: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

tr56.name: TR56
tr56.flavor_text_es: Libera, desde su interior, una inmensa descarga de aura. Es infalible.
tr56.flavor_text_en: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

tr57.name: TR57
tr57.flavor_text_es: Pincha al objetivo con un tentáculo o brazo envenenado. Puede llegar a envenenar al objetivo.
tr57.flavor_text_en: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

tr58.name: TR58
tr58.flavor_text_es: Libera una horrible aura llena de malos pensamientos que puede amedrentar al objetivo.
tr58.flavor_text_en: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

tr59.name: TR59
tr59.flavor_text_es: Lanza al objetivo una descarga de semillas explosivas desde arriba.
tr59.flavor_text_en: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

tr60.name: TR60
tr60.flavor_text_es: Cruza las guadañas o las garras para atacar al objetivo como si fueran unas tijeras.
tr60.flavor_text_en: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tr61.name: TR61
tr61.flavor_text_es: El usuario crea una onda sónica dañina moviendo su cuerpo que también puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr61.flavor_text_en: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr62.name: TR62
tr62.flavor_text_es: Abre mucho la boca y libera una onda de choque que ataca al objetivo.
tr62.flavor_text_en: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tr63.name: TR63
tr63.flavor_text_es: Ataca con un rayo de luz que centellea como si lo formaran miles de joyas.
tr63.flavor_text_en: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

tr64.name: TR64
tr64.flavor_text_es: Agudiza la concentración mental y libera su poder. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr64.flavor_text_en: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr65.name: TR65
tr65.flavor_text_es: Aúna fuerzas de la naturaleza y libera su ataque. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr65.flavor_text_en: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr66.name: TR66
tr66.flavor_text_es: Pliega sus alas y ataca con un vuelo rasante. El Pokémon que lo usa también resulta seriamente dañado.
tr66.flavor_text_en: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

tr67.name: TR67
tr67.flavor_text_es: La tierra a los pies del objetivo erupciona violentamente. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr67.flavor_text_en: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr68.name: TR68
tr68.flavor_text_es: Estimula su cerebro pensando en cosas malas. Aumenta mucho el Ataque Especial.
tr68.flavor_text_en: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr69.name: TR69
tr69.flavor_text_es: Concentra su energía psíquica en la cabeza para golpear. Puede hacer que el objetivo se amedrente.
tr69.flavor_text_en: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

tr70.name: TR70
tr70.flavor_text_es: El usuario concentra toda la luz del cuerpo y la libera. Puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tr70.flavor_text_en: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr71.name: TR71
tr71.flavor_text_es: Envuelve al objetivo con una lluvia de hojas afiladas, pero reduce mucho su Ataque Especial.
tr71.flavor_text_en: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr72.name: TR72
tr72.flavor_text_es: El usuario agita violentamente sus lianas o tentáculos para golpear al objetivo.
tr72.flavor_text_en: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

tr73.name: TR73
tr73.flavor_text_es: Lanza contra el objetivo basura asquerosa y puede envenenarlo.
tr73.flavor_text_en: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

tr74.name: TR74
tr74.flavor_text_es: Ataca con su dura cabeza de hierro. Puede hacer que el objetivo se amedrente.
tr74.flavor_text_en: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

tr75.name: TR75
tr75.flavor_text_es: Clava piedras muy afiladas al objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
tr75.flavor_text_en: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

tr76.name: TR76
tr76.flavor_text_es: Una trampa de rocas que flota en el aire y daña a los objetivos que entran en combate.
tr76.flavor_text_en: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr77.name: TR77
tr77.flavor_text_es: Enreda al objetivo con hierba y lo derriba. Cuanto más pesado es el objetivo, más daño inflige.
tr77.flavor_text_en: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr78.name: TR78
tr78.flavor_text_es: Una onda tóxica que daña a los Pokémon de alrededor. Puede envenenar.
tr78.flavor_text_en: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

tr79.name: TR79
tr79.flavor_text_es: El usuario golpea con todo su cuerpo. Cuanto mayor sea su peso comparado con el del objetivo, más daño causará.
tr79.flavor_text_en: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr80.name: TR80
tr80.flavor_text_es: Lanza una bola eléctrica. Cuanto mayor sea la Velocidad del usuario en comparación con la del objetivo, mayor será el daño causado.
tr80.flavor_text_en: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr81.name: TR81
tr81.flavor_text_es: El usuario emplea la fuerza del objetivo para atacarlo. Cuanto mayor es el Ataque del objetivo, más daño provoca.
tr81.flavor_text_en: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

tr82.name: TR82
tr82.flavor_text_es: Acumula poder para golpear. Cuanto más suban las características del usuario, mayor será el daño.
tr82.flavor_text_en: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.

tr83.name: TR83
tr83.flavor_text_es: Extraño poder que intercambia la posición del usuario con la de un aliado sobre el terreno de combate.
tr83.flavor_text_en: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

tr84.name: TR84
tr84.flavor_text_es: Ataca arrojando agua hirviendo al objetivo. Puede causar quemaduras.
tr84.flavor_text_en: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr85.name: TR85
tr85.flavor_text_es: Quien lo usa se concentra y potencia su Ataque y su Ataque Especial.
tr85.flavor_text_en: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

tr86.name: TR86
tr86.flavor_text_es: Carga eléctrica muy potente que también hiere ligeramente a quien la usa.
tr86.flavor_text_en: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

tr87.name: TR87
tr87.flavor_text_es: El usuario golpea usando su cuerpo como un taladro. Suele ser crítico.
tr87.flavor_text_en: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

tr88.name: TR88
tr88.flavor_text_es: El usuario ataca con su cuerpo ardiente. Cuanto mayor sea su peso comparado con el del objetivo, más daño causará.
tr88.flavor_text_en: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr89.name: TR89
tr89.flavor_text_es: Golpea al objetivo con un fuerte torbellino que envuelve al rival y puede confundirlo.
tr89.flavor_text_en: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

tr90.name: TR90
tr90.flavor_text_es: El Pokémon que lo usa le hace cucamonas al objetivo y lo ataca. Puede disminuir el Ataque del objetivo.
tr90.flavor_text_en: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

tr91.name: TR91
tr91.flavor_text_es: Impregna a su objetivo con un líquido venenoso que disminuye el Ataque, el Ataque Especial y la Velocidad. Solo afecta a Pokémon ya envenenados.
tr91.flavor_text_en: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

tr92.name: TR92
tr92.flavor_text_es: Inflige daño a los oponentes con una potente luz.
tr92.flavor_text_en: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

tr93.name: TR93
tr93.flavor_text_es: Gira sobre sí mismo y golpea al oponente con ambos brazos. Ignora los cambios en las características del objetivo.
tr93.flavor_text_en: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

tr94.name: TR94
tr94.flavor_text_es: Asesta un golpe devastador usando todo su cuerpo.
tr94.flavor_text_en: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

tr95.name: TR95
tr95.flavor_text_es: Inflige al rival un dolor tan abrumador que le impide utilizar durante dos turnos ataques que se sirven del sonido.
tr95.flavor_text_en: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

tr96.name: TR96
tr96.flavor_text_es: Ataca al oponente con una bola explosiva. Si esta alcanza a un aliado, le hará recuperar PS.
tr96.flavor_text_en: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

tr97.name: TR97
tr97.flavor_text_es: Ataca a sus rivales con poderes psíquicos que además destruyen barreras como Pantalla de Luz y Reflejo.
tr97.flavor_text_en: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

tr98.name: TR98
tr98.flavor_text_es: Ataca golpeando gracias a la fuerza del agua. También puede reducir la Defensa del objetivo.
tr98.flavor_text_en: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr99.name: TR99
tr99.flavor_text_es: El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.
tr99.flavor_text_en: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

tm00.name: TM00
tm00.flavor_text_en: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

lonely-mint.name: Lonely Mint
lonely-mint.flavor_text_es: Cuando un Pokémon percibe su aroma, aumenta con más facilidad su Ataque, en detrimento de su Defensa.
lonely-mint.flavor_text_en: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Defense will grow more slowly.
