naive-mint.flavor_text_es: Cuando un Pokémon percibe su aroma, aumenta con más facilidad su Velocidad, en detrimento de su Defensa Especial.
naive-mint.flavor_text_en: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.

serious-mint.name: Serious Mint
serious-mint.flavor_text_es: Cuando un Pokémon percibe su aroma, su Ataque, Defensa, Velocidad, Defensa Especial y Ataque Especial crecen de forma uniforme.
serious-mint.flavor_text_en: When a Pokémon smells this mint, all of its stats will grow at an equal rate.

wishing-piece.name: Wishing Piece
wishing-piece.flavor_text_es: Al lanzarlo en un nido Pokémon, aparece un Pokémon Dinamax.
wishing-piece.flavor_text_en: Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.

cracked-pot.name: Cracked Pot
cracked-pot.flavor_text_es: Curiosa tetera que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Pese a estar agrietada, sirve un té exquisito.
cracked-pot.flavor_text_en: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It may be cracked, but tea poured from it is delicious.

chipped-pot.name: Chipped Pot
chipped-pot.flavor_text_es: Curiosa tetera que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Pese a estar rota, sirve un té exquisito.
chipped-pot.flavor_text_en: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It may be chipped, but tea poured from it is delicious.

hi-tech-earbuds.name: Hi-tech Earbuds
hi-tech-earbuds.flavor_text_es: Curiosos auriculares que permiten ajustar de forma independiente el volumen de distintos elementos sonoros.
hi-tech-earbuds.flavor_text_en: Strange earbuds that allow you to freely control the volume of various sounds.

fruit-bunch.name: Fruit Bunch
fruit-bunch.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. La jugosa fruta aporta un toque tropical al plato.
fruit-bunch.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The syrupy fruits give off a strong tropical feel.

moomoo-cheese.name: Moomoo Cheese
moomoo-cheese.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. El queso derretido aporta intensidad a la salsa.
moomoo-cheese.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Melted cheese can really give a curry some richness.

spice-mix.name: Spice Mix
spice-mix.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Es una mezcla picante de más de 50 tipos de especias.
spice-mix.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. There are over fifty spices contained within this ingredient’s hot flavor.

fresh-cream.name: Fresh Cream
fresh-cream.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. La nata da un toque dulce a la salsa picante del curri.
fresh-cream.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Add some whipped cream to a spicy curry to give it some sweetness.

packaged-curry.name: Packaged Curry
packaged-curry.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Este curri precocinado nunca falla.
packaged-curry.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Using packaged curry helps make sure there are no slipups when cooking.

coconut-milk.name: Coconut Milk
coconut-milk.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Muy popular por el dulzor refinado que aporta al plato.
coconut-milk.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The refined sweetness of this coconut milk makes it quite popular.

instant-noodles.name: Instant Noodles
instant-noodles.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. El sabor reconfortante de estos fideos casa inesperadamente bien con la salsa de curri.
instant-noodles.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It has a junk-food sort of taste, but it goes well with curry.

precooked-burger.name: Precooked Burger
precooked-burger.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Una apuesta segura, perfecta para esos momentos de duda.
precooked-burger.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. If you’re unsure about what to cook, you can’t go wrong with some burger.

gigantamix.name: Gigantamix
gigantamix.flavor_text_es: Un ingrediente para cocinar en el campamento. Una pizca de esta extraña especia basta para elaborar un curri gigantesco.
gigantamix.flavor_text_en: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. A mysterious spice. Even a tiny sprinkle is sure to make a curry gigantic.

wishing-chip.name: Wishing Chip
wishing-chip.flavor_text_es: Al lanzar unos cuantos a un nido Pokémon, es posible que aparezca algún Pokémon Dinamax.
wishing-chip.flavor_text_en: Toss a number of them into a Pokémon Den for the chance to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.

rotom-bike--water-mode.name: Rotom Bike
rotom-bike--water-mode.flavor_text_es: Combinada con el Pokémon Rotom, esta bicicleta te permite usar un turbo y también desplazarte por encima del agua.
rotom-bike--water-mode.flavor_text_en: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to not only do a turbo boost but also run on the water.

catching-charm.name: Catching Charm
catching-charm.flavor_text_es: Aumenta la probabilidad de lograr una captura crítica al llevarlo equipado. Curiosamente, apenas vibra.
catching-charm.flavor_text_en: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, the charm doesn’t shake much.

old-letter.name: Old Letter
old-letter.flavor_text_es: Carta de aspecto desgastado entregada por una niña y con un chico como destinatario.
old-letter.flavor_text_en: A letter entrusted to you by a girl, to be delivered to a boy. Strangely, it looks old to you.

band-autograph.name: Band Autograph
band-autograph.flavor_text_es: Un autógrafo firmado por todos los miembros de los Maximizers, el grupo musical más carismático de Galar.
band-autograph.flavor_text_en: It’s signed by all members of the Galar region’s most charismatic band, the Maximizers.

sonias-book.name: Sonia’s Book
sonias-book.flavor_text_es: Publicación de la Profesora Sonia que trata de forma amena los recientes descubrimientos sobre las leyendas de la región de Galar.
sonias-book.flavor_text_en: Professor Sonia’s published writings. Her new discoveries about the Galar region’s legends are recorded in this enjoyable read.

rotom-catalog.name: Rotom Catalog
rotom-catalog.flavor_text_es: Un catálogo de los artilugios favoritos de Rotom que le permite introducirse o salir fácilmente de los mismos.
rotom-catalog.flavor_text_en: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

dynamax-crystal-and458.name: ★And458
dynamax-crystal-and458.flavor_text_es: Posibilita la aparición de [VAR (0000)] en el nido Dinamax de la Atalaya del Área Silvestre hasta finalizar el día en que se ha usado.
dynamax-crystal-and458.flavor_text_en: An item that causes [VAR (0000)] to appear from the Watchtower Lair in the Wild Area until the end of the day.

max-honey.name: Max Honey
max-honey.flavor_text_es: Panal construido por Vespiquen Dinamax cuya densa miel suaviza el sabor de la Maxisopa. También tiene el mismo efecto que un Revivir Máximo.
max-honey.flavor_text_en: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

max-mushrooms.name: Max Mushrooms
max-mushrooms.flavor_text_es: Una seta capaz de cambiar el aspecto de los Pokémon al dinamaxizarse. Aumenta todas las características de un Pokémon si se usa en combate.
max-mushrooms.flavor_text_en: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

galarica-twig.name: Galarica Twig
galarica-twig.flavor_text_es: Una rama de un árbol llamado Galanuez, que crece en determinadas zonas de Galar. Con ella se pueden crear accesorios para cierto Pokémon.
galarica-twig.flavor_text_en: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

galarica-cuff.name: Galarica Cuff
galarica-cuff.flavor_text_es: Un brazalete hecho de Ramas de Galanuez trenzadas. Los Slowpoke de Galar se ponen contentísimos si lo reciben como regalo.
galarica-cuff.flavor_text_en: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

style-card.name: Style Card
style-card.flavor_text_es: Una tarjeta que aumenta la selección de artículos disponibles en las tiendas y permite elegir entre una mayor variedad de peinados en las peluquerías.
style-card.flavor_text_en: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.

armor-pass.name: Armor Pass
armor-pass.flavor_text_es: Un pase que permite viajar hasta la Isla de la Armadura. Hay que mostrárselo al empleado de la estación de Pueblo Par.
armor-pass.flavor_text_en: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

rotom-bike--sparkling-white.name: Rotom Bike
rotom-bike--sparkling-white.flavor_text_es: Gracias al poder de Rotom, esta bicicleta permite usar el turbo y desplazarse sobre el agua. Tiene un color blanco centelleante.
rotom-bike--sparkling-white.flavor_text_en: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that shines brilliantly.

rotom-bike--glistening-black.name: Rotom Bike
rotom-bike--glistening-black.flavor_text_es: Gracias al poder de Rotom, esta bicicleta permite usar el turbo y desplazarse sobre el agua. De color negro y con una fulgurante estela rojinegra.
rotom-bike--glistening-black.flavor_text_en: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that shines reddish-black.

exp-charm.name: Exp. Charm
exp-charm.flavor_text_es: Amuleto que aumenta los Puntos de Experiencia que reciben los Pokémon. Su interior contiene una especie de mecanismo.
exp-charm.flavor_text_en: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

armorite-ore.name: Armorite Ore
armorite-ore.flavor_text_es: Un mineral poco común que se encuentra en la Isla de la Armadura. Tal vez ocurra algo bueno al dárselo a un coleccionista de dicha isla.
armorite-ore.flavor_text_en: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

mark-charm.name: Mark Charm
mark-charm.flavor_text_es: Misterioso y particular amuleto que aumenta las posibilidades de encontrar Pokémon con emblemas.
mark-charm.flavor_text_en: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

reins-of-unity--merge.name: Reins of Unity
reins-of-unity--merge.flavor_text_es: Riendas que se entregaron como ofrenda al rey. Potencian los poderes de Calyrex para mejorar las cosechas y le permiten unirse con su amado corcel.
reins-of-unity--merge.flavor_text_en: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

reins-of-unity--split.name: Reins of Unity
reins-of-unity--split.flavor_text_es: Riendas que se entregaron como ofrenda al rey. Permiten el entendimiento mutuo entre aquellos que están unidos y separan a Calyrex de su amado corcel.
reins-of-unity--split.flavor_text_en: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

galarica-wreath.name: Galarica Wreath
galarica-wreath.flavor_text_es: Una corona hecha de Ramas de Galanuez trenzadas. Los Slowpoke de Galar se ponen contentísimos cuando la llevan puesta.
galarica-wreath.flavor_text_en: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

legendary-clue-1.name: Legendary Clue 1
legendary-clue-1.flavor_text_es: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda del Rey de las Cosechas. Lleva adjunta una vieja fotografía.
legendary-clue-1.flavor_text_en: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

legendary-clue-2.name: Legendary Clue 2
legendary-clue-2.flavor_text_es: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda de los gigantes. Contiene unas ilustraciones muy particulares.
legendary-clue-2.flavor_text_en: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.

legendary-clue-3.name: Legendary Clue 3
legendary-clue-3.flavor_text_es: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda de las aves legendarias. Contiene una ilustración muy particular.
legendary-clue-3.flavor_text_en: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

legendary-clue-question.name: Legendary Clue?
legendary-clue-question.flavor_text_es: Una extraña nota que se le cayó a Peony. Tiene pegada una foto del Supernido Dinamax en la que se ve una cavidad luminosa.
legendary-clue-question.flavor_text_en: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

crown-pass.name: Crown Pass
crown-pass.flavor_text_es: Un pase que permite viajar hasta las Nieves de la Corona. Hay que mostrárselo al empleado de la estación de Pueblo Par.
crown-pass.flavor_text_en: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

wooden-crown.name: Wooden Crown
wooden-crown.flavor_text_es: Un misterioso objeto hecho de madera. Las marcas que presenta parecen indicar que no está completo, como si formase parte de algo.
wooden-crown.flavor_text_en: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

radiant-petal.name: Radiant Petal
radiant-petal.flavor_text_es: Un pétalo recibido del Rey de las Cosechas. Emite una luz tenue.
radiant-petal.flavor_text_en: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

white-mane-hair.name: White Mane Hair
white-mane-hair.flavor_text_es: Parte de la crin de Glastrier, el amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas. Es flexible y resistente.
white-mane-hair.flavor_text_en: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

black-mane-hair.name: Black Mane Hair
black-mane-hair.flavor_text_es: Parte de la crin de Spectrier, el amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas. Es suave al tacto.
black-mane-hair.flavor_text_en: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

iceroot-carrot.name: Iceroot Carrot
iceroot-carrot.flavor_text_es: Una zanahoria cultivada en un huerto rebosante de nieve. Es la hortaliza preferida del amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas.
iceroot-carrot.flavor_text_en: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

shaderoot-carrot.name: Shaderoot Carrot
shaderoot-carrot.flavor_text_es: Una zanahoria cultivada en un huerto sombrío. Es la hortaliza preferida del amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas.
shaderoot-carrot.flavor_text_en: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

dynite-ore.name: Dynite Ore
dynite-ore.flavor_text_es: Un extraño mineral que se encuentra en el Supernido Dinamax. Tal vez ocurra algo bueno al dárselo a un coleccionista de las Nieves de la Corona.
dynite-ore.flavor_text_en: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

carrot-seeds.name: Carrot Seeds
carrot-seeds.flavor_text_es: Semillas para plantar en un huerto. Permiten obtener un tipo u otro de zanahoria en función del lugar elegido para su cultivo.
carrot-seeds.flavor_text_en: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

ability-patch.name: Ability Patch
ability-patch.flavor_text_es: Parche que permite cambiar la habilidad normal de un Pokémon a otra menos común.
ability-patch.flavor_text_en: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

reins-of-unity.name: Reins of Unity
reins-of-unity.flavor_text_es: Correas elaboradas con un tejido que brilla bajo la luz. En el pasado, los humanos las entregaban como ofrenda al Rey de las Cosechas en señal de gratitud.
reins-of-unity.flavor_text_en: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

laheavy-ball.name: Heavy Ball
laheavy-ball.flavor_text_en: Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

laleaden-ball.name: Leaden Ball
laleaden-ball.flavor_text_en: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

lagigaton-ball.name: Gigaton Ball
lagigaton-ball.flavor_text_en: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

lafeather-ball.name: Feather Ball
lafeather-ball.flavor_text_en: Can be thrown further than a regular Poké Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

lawing-ball.name: Wing Ball
lawing-ball.flavor_text_en: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

lajet-ball.name: Jet Ball
lajet-ball.flavor_text_en: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
